# Investigating Ghidra MCP Server Inventory Items (2026-02-09 11:36Z)

_**User (2026-02-09 11:39Z)**_

I want you to investigate against the ghidra mcp server, where and when the inventory items 95 and 96 are added to the players inventory. These seem to be, respectively, a CD player and a Book of the game's backgrounds, and they can be used to launch a cd player that reproduces all the music in thegame, and a book with all the backgrounds of the game. 

I want to figure out what conditions trigger the obtaining of these, and then how they work respectively, when used with alfred himself. 

In the game I tested this by using the command line parameters o 95 and o 96 which start the game with them in the inventory. I can see using the cd player on alfred triggers teh player, but then it doesnt really work. The book is fully functional.

Find all of these things for me, rename stuff on ghidra, and create a documentation on your findings.


---

_**Agent (model copilot/claude-opus-4.5)**_

    "original": "cd /Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools &amp;&amp; python3 -c \"\n# Read the JUEGO.EXE to find the item combination table at 0x48118\n# Table format: [item1_id(2), item2_id(2), function_ptr(4)] = 8 bytes per entry\nwith open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    # EXE base is typically around 0x10000 for DOS, but let's check the offset\n    # The Ghidra addresses seem to be image-relative, so 0x48118 should be direct\n    # But we need to account for the MZ header offset\n    f.seek(0x38118)  # 0x48118 - 0x10000 (typical DOS load address difference)\n    print('Reading item combination table at file offset 0x38118 (Ghidra: 0x48118):')\n    print('Format: [item1_id, item2_id, function_ptr]')\n    print('-' * 60)\n    for i in range(100):  # Read up to 100 entries\n        entry = f.read(8)\n        if len(entry) &lt; 8:\n            break\n        item1 = int.from_bytes(entry[0:2], 'little')\n        item2 = int.from_bytes(entry[2:4], 'little')\n        func_ptr = int.from_bytes(entry[4:8], 'little')\n        if item1 == 0xFFFF:\n            print(f'Entry {i}: END OF TABLE (0xFFFF)')\n            break\n        # Look for items 95 (0x5F) and 96 (0x60)\n        marker = ''\n        if item1 == 95 or item2 == 95:\n            marker = ' &lt;-- ITEM 95 (CD Player)'\n        if item1 == 96 or item2 == 96:\n            marker = ' &lt;-- ITEM 96 (Background Book)'\n        print(f'Entry {i:3d}: item1={item1:3d} (0x{item1:02x}), item2={item2:3d} (0x{item2:02x}), handler=0x{func_ptr:08x}{marker}')\n\" 2&gt;&amp;1 | tee /tmp/item_table.txt",

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nFind handlers for items 95 and 96 in the item combination table.\n\"\"\"\n\n# Read the JUEGO.EXE to find the item combination table at 0x48118\n# Table format: [item1_id(2), item2_id(2), function_ptr(4)] = 8 bytes per entry\nwith open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    # EXE base is typically around 0x10000 for DOS, but let's check the offset\n    # The Ghidra addresses seem to be image-relative, so 0x48118 should be direct\n    # But we need to account for the MZ header offset\n    f.seek(0x38118)  # 0x48118 - 0x10000 (typical DOS load address difference)\n    print('Reading item combination table at file offset 0x38118 (Ghidra: 0x48118):')\n    print('Format: [item1_id, item2_id, function_ptr]')\n    print('-' * 70)\n    for i in range(100):  # Read up to 100 entries\n        entry = f.read(8)\n        if len(entry) &lt; 8:\n            break\n        item1 = int.from_bytes(entry[0:2], 'little')\n        item2 = int.from_bytes(entry[2:4], 'little')\n        func_ptr = int.from_bytes(entry[4:8], 'little')\n        if item1 == 0xFFFF:\n            print(f'Entry {i}: END OF TABLE (0xFFFF)')\n            break\n        # Look for items 95 (0x5F) and 96 (0x60)\n        marker = ''\n        if item1 == 95 or item2 == 95:\n            marker = ' &lt;-- ITEM 95 (CD Player/Soundtrack)'\n        if item1 == 96 or item2 == 96:\n            marker = ' &lt;-- ITEM 96 (Background Book)'\n        print(f'Entry {i:3d}: item1={item1:3d} (0x{item1:02x}), item2={item2:3d} (0x{item2:02x}), handler=0x{func_ptr:08x}{marker}')\n\nprint()\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\nprint(\"Now searching for uses of items 95 and 96 in other tables...\")\nprint()\n\n# Also check the hotspot extra action table at 0x47bf0\n# Table format: [hotspot_extra_id(2), function_ptr(4)] = 6 bytes per entry\nf.seek(0x37bf0)  # 0x47bf0 - 0x10000\nprint('Reading hotspot extra action table at file offset 0x37bf0 (Ghidra: 0x47bf0):')\nprint('Format: [hotspot_extra_id, function_ptr]')\nprint('-' * 70)\nfor i in range(200):  # Read up to 200 entries\n    with open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n        f.seek(0x37bf0 + i * 6)\n        entry = f.read(6)\n        if len(entry) &lt; 6:\n            break\n        extra_id = int.from_bytes(entry[0:2], 'little')\n        func_ptr = int.from_bytes(entry[2:6], 'little')\n        if extra_id == 0xFFFF:\n            print(f'Entry {i}: END OF TABLE (0xFFFF)')\n            break\n        # Look for items 95 (0x5F) and 96 (0x60) \n        marker = ''\n        if extra_id == 95:\n            marker = ' &lt;-- EXTRA 95'\n        if extra_id == 96:\n            marker = ' &lt;-- EXTRA 96'\n        if marker or i &lt; 10 or extra_id &gt; 300:\n            print(f'Entry {i:3d}: extra_id={extra_id:4d} (0x{extra_id:03x}), handler=0x{func_ptr:08x}{marker}')\n",

  "content": "",
  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nFind the correct offset mapping for JUEGO.EXE and locate handlers for items 95 and 96.\n\"\"\"\nimport struct\n\n# Check DOS EXE header\nwith open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    magic = f.read(2)\n    print(f'Magic: {magic}')\n    \n    # Read MZ header\n    f.seek(0)\n    header = f.read(0x40)\n    last_page_size = struct.unpack('&lt;H', header[2:4])[0]\n    pages = struct.unpack('&lt;H', header[4:6])[0]\n    header_size_para = struct.unpack('&lt;H', header[8:10])[0]\n    print(f'Last page size: {last_page_size}')\n    print(f'Pages: {pages}')\n    print(f'Header size paragraphs: {header_size_para}')\n    print(f'Header size bytes: {header_size_para * 16}')\n    \n    # Total file size check\n    f.seek(0, 2)\n    file_size = f.tell()\n    print(f'File size: {file_size} bytes')\n    \n    # For DOS4GW/DOS32A, the load address is usually 0x10000\n    # Let's search for a known pattern to find the offset\n    \n    # Let's look for \"Tic-Tac-Toe 1995\" string which should be at 0x49590 in Ghidra\n    f.seek(0)\n    data = f.read()\n    \n    search = b\"Tic-Tac-Toe 1995\"\n    pos = data.find(search)\n    if pos != -1:\n        print(f'\\nFound \"Tic-Tac-Toe 1995\" at file offset 0x{pos:x}')\n        print(f'Ghidra address: 0x49590')\n        offset = 0x49590 - pos\n        print(f'Address offset (Ghidra - file): 0x{offset:x}')\n    else:\n        print('\\nString not found!')\n        \n    # Also search for \"Inicializando CD-ROM\"\n    search2 = b\"Inicializando CD-ROM\"\n    pos2 = data.find(search2)\n    if pos2 != -1:\n        print(f'\\nFound \"Inicializando CD-ROM\" at file offset 0x{pos2:x}')\n        print(f'Ghidra address: 0x46a9a')\n        offset2 = 0x46a9a - pos2\n        print(f'Address offset (Ghidra - file): 0x{offset2:x}')\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nFind handlers for items 95 and 96 in the item combination table.\n\"\"\"\nimport struct\nimport sys\n\nsys.stdout = open('item_handlers_analysis.txt', 'w')\n\n# File offset = Ghidra address + 0x3200\nOFFSET = 0x3200\n\n# Item combination table at Ghidra 0x48118\n# Table format: [item1_id(2), item2_id(2), function_ptr(4)] = 8 bytes per entry\ntable_ghidra = 0x48118\ntable_file = table_ghidra + OFFSET\n\nprint('=' * 80)\nprint('ITEM COMBINATION TABLE ANALYSIS')\nprint('=' * 80)\nprint(f'Item combination table at Ghidra 0x{table_ghidra:x} (file 0x{table_file:x})')\nprint('Format: [item1_id(2), item2_id(2), function_ptr(4)] = 8 bytes per entry')\nprint('-' * 80)\n\nwith open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    f.seek(table_file)\n    for i in range(200):  # Read up to 200 entries\n        entry = f.read(8)\n        if len(entry) &lt; 8:\n            break\n        item1 = struct.unpack('&lt;H', entry[0:2])[0]\n        item2 = struct.unpack('&lt;H', entry[2:4])[0]\n        func_ptr = struct.unpack('&lt;I', entry[4:8])[0]\n        if item1 == 0xFFFF:\n            print(f'Entry {i}: END OF TABLE (0xFFFF)')\n            break\n        # Look for items 95 (0x5F) and 96 (0x60)\n        marker = ''\n        if item1 == 95 or item2 == 95:\n            marker = ' &lt;=== ITEM 95 (CD Player/Soundtrack)'\n        if item1 == 96 or item2 == 96:\n            marker = ' &lt;=== ITEM 96 (Background Book)'\n        # Also look for item 1 (using on Alfred himself - hotspot 1)\n        if item1 == 1 or item2 == 1:\n            marker += ' (involves item 1 - might be Alfred)'\n        print(f'Entry {i:3d}: item1={item1:3d} (0x{item1:02x}), item2={item2:3d} (0x{item2:02x}), handler=0x{func_ptr:08x}{marker}')\n\nprint()\nprint('=' * 80)\nprint('HOTSPOT EXTRA ACTION TABLE')\nprint('=' * 80)\n\n# Hotspot extra action table at Ghidra 0x47bf0\n# Table format: [hotspot_extra_id(2), function_ptr(4)] = 6 bytes per entry\nhotspot_table_ghidra = 0x47bf0\nhotspot_table_file = hotspot_table_ghidra + OFFSET\n\nprint(f'Hotspot extra action table at Ghidra 0x{hotspot_table_ghidra:x} (file 0x{hotspot_table_file:x})')\nprint('Format: [hotspot_extra_id(2), function_ptr(4)] = 6 bytes per entry')\nprint('-' * 80)\n\nwith open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    f.seek(hotspot_table_file)\n    for i in range(400):  # Read up to 400 entries\n        entry = f.read(6)\n        if len(entry) &lt; 6:\n            break\n        extra_id = struct.unpack('&lt;H', entry[0:2])[0]\n        func_ptr = struct.unpack('&lt;I', entry[2:6])[0]\n        if extra_id == 0xFFFF:\n            print(f'Entry {i}: END OF TABLE (0xFFFF)')\n            break\n        # Look for extra IDs 95 and 96\n        marker = ''\n        if extra_id == 95:\n            marker = ' &lt;=== EXTRA ID 95'\n        if extra_id == 96:\n            marker = ' &lt;=== EXTRA ID 96'\n        # Only print interesting entries\n        if marker or i &lt; 15:\n            print(f'Entry {i:3d}: extra_id={extra_id:4d} (0x{extra_id:03x}), handler=0x{func_ptr:08x}{marker}')\n\nprint()\nprint('=' * 80)\nprint('SEARCHING FOR ITEM 95 AND 96 BYTES')\nprint('=' * 80)\n\n# Search for 0x5F 0x00 (95) and 0x60 0x00 (96) as word values\nwith open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    data = f.read()\n\n# Search for word value 95 (0x5F 0x00 in little-endian)\ntarget_95 = b'\\x5f\\x00'\ntarget_96 = b'\\x60\\x00'\n\nprint(f'\\nSearching for word value 95 (0x005F):')\npos = 0\ncount = 0\nwhile True:\n    pos = data.find(target_95, pos)\n    if pos == -1:\n        break\n    ghidra_addr = pos - OFFSET\n    # Check if this is in a reasonable code/data section\n    if 0x10000 &lt; ghidra_addr &lt; 0x60000:\n        count += 1\n        if count &lt; 30:\n            print(f'  Found at file 0x{pos:05x} (Ghidra 0x{ghidra_addr:05x})')\n    pos += 1\nprint(f'  Total occurrences in reasonable range: {count}')\n\nprint(f'\\nSearching for word value 96 (0x0060):')\npos = 0\ncount = 0\nwhile True:\n    pos = data.find(target_96, pos)\n    if pos == -1:\n        break\n    ghidra_addr = pos - OFFSET\n    # Check if this is in a reasonable code/data section\n    if 0x10000 &lt; ghidra_addr &lt; 0x60000:\n        count += 1\n        if count &lt; 30:\n            print(f'  Found at file 0x{pos:05x} (Ghidra 0x{ghidra_addr:05x})')\n    pos += 1\nprint(f'  Total occurrences in reasonable range: {count}')\n\nprint('\\nDone!')\nsys.stdout.close()\n",

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nAnalyze the item 95 and 96 handlers by reading bytes from the EXE.\n\"\"\"\nimport struct\nimport sys\n\nsys.stdout = open('item95_96_handler_analysis.txt', 'w')\n\n# File offset = Ghidra address + 0x3200\nOFFSET = 0x3200\n\ndef read_bytes_at(data, ghidra_addr, length):\n    \"\"\"Read bytes at a Ghidra address.\"\"\"\n    file_offset = ghidra_addr + OFFSET\n    return data[file_offset:file_offset + length]\n\nwith open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    data = f.read()\n\nprint('=' * 80)\nprint('ITEM 95 HANDLER ANALYSIS (CD Player / Soundtrack)')\nprint('=' * 80)\nprint(f'Handler at Ghidra 0x146f4, file offset 0x{0x146f4 + OFFSET:x}')\nprint()\n\n# Read 200 bytes of code at the handler\ncode_95 = read_bytes_at(data, 0x146f4, 200)\nprint('First 200 bytes (hex):')\nfor i in range(0, 200, 16):\n    addr = 0x146f4 + i\n    line = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in code_95[i:i+16])\n    print(f'  0x{addr:05x}: {line}')\n\nprint()\nprint('=' * 80)\nprint('ITEM 96 HANDLER ANALYSIS (Background Book)')\nprint('=' * 80)\nprint(f'Handler at Ghidra 0x14ed7, file offset 0x{0x14ed7 + OFFSET:x}')\nprint()\n\n# Read 200 bytes of code at the handler\ncode_96 = read_bytes_at(data, 0x14ed7, 200)\nprint('First 200 bytes (hex):')\nfor i in range(0, 200, 16):\n    addr = 0x14ed7 + i\n    line = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in code_96[i:i+16])\n    print(f'  0x{addr:05x}: {line}')\n\nprint()\nprint('=' * 80)\nprint('SEARCHING FOR WHERE ITEM 95 AND 96 ARE ADDED TO INVENTORY')\nprint('=' * 80)\nprint()\n\n# The value at inventory_item_ids[num_available_actions] gets set with an item ID\n# We need to find where 95 or 96 is written to the inventory\n\n# Search for patterns that might add items 95 or 96 to inventory\n# Common patterns: MOV word ptr [...], 0x5F or MOV word ptr [...], 0x60\n\n# Pattern: C7 (MOV opcode for immediate to memory) followed by 5F 00 or 60 00\nprint('Looking for MOV instruction patterns that set value to 95 or 96...')\n\nfor item, value in [(95, 0x5F), (96, 0x60)]:\n    print(f'\\nItem {item} (0x{value:02x}):')\n    \n    # Pattern 1: MOV word ptr [mem], imm16 - 66 C7 05 &lt;addr32&gt; &lt;imm16&gt;\n    # Pattern 2: MOV byte ptr [mem], imm8 - C6 05 &lt;addr32&gt; &lt;imm8&gt;\n    # Pattern 3: MOV ax/eax, imm then store\n    \n    # Search for the immediate value 0x5F00 or 0x6000 (little-endian word)\n    pattern = bytes([value, 0x00])\n    pos = 0\n    found = []\n    while True:\n        pos = data.find(pattern, pos)\n        if pos == -1:\n            break\n        ghidra_addr = pos - OFFSET\n        # Check if in code section (roughly 0x10000 - 0x40000)\n        if 0x10000 &lt; ghidra_addr &lt; 0x40000:\n            # Look at context to see if it's part of a MOV instruction\n            context_start = max(0, pos - 8)\n            context = data[context_start:pos + 6]\n            # Check for common instruction patterns\n            found.append((ghidra_addr, context.hex()))\n        pos += 1\n    \n    print(f'  Found {len(found)} occurrences in code section:')\n    for addr, ctx in found[:20]:  # Show first 20\n        print(f'    0x{addr:05x}: context = {ctx}')\n\nprint()\nprint('=' * 80)\nprint('CHECKING SPECIFIC ADDRESSES FROM EARLIER SEARCH')\nprint('=' * 80)\n\n# From earlier: Found at file 0x4b470 (Ghidra 0x48270) - this is in the item table\n# Let's check nearby code that might write to inventory\n\n# The item table entry for item 95 is at 0x48118 + 43*8 = 0x48270\n# Item 96 is at 0x48118 + 44*8 = 0x48278\nprint(f'\\nItem 95 table entry at Ghidra 0x{0x48118 + 43*8:x}')\nprint(f'Item 96 table entry at Ghidra 0x{0x48118 + 44*8:x}')\n\n# Let's verify by reading the table entries\nentry_95 = read_bytes_at(data, 0x48118 + 43*8, 8)\nentry_96 = read_bytes_at(data, 0x48118 + 44*8, 8)\n\nitem1_95 = struct.unpack('&lt;H', entry_95[0:2])[0]\nitem2_95 = struct.unpack('&lt;H', entry_95[2:4])[0]\nhandler_95 = struct.unpack('&lt;I', entry_95[4:8])[0]\n\nitem1_96 = struct.unpack('&lt;H', entry_96[0:2])[0]\nitem2_96 = struct.unpack('&lt;H', entry_96[2:4])[0]\nhandler_96 = struct.unpack('&lt;I', entry_96[4:8])[0]\n\nprint(f'\\nEntry 43: item1={item1_95}, item2={item2_95}, handler=0x{handler_95:08x}')\nprint(f'Entry 44: item1={item1_96}, item2={item2_96}, handler=0x{handler_96:08x}')\n\nsys.stdout.close()\n",

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nDisassemble the handlers for items 95 and 96.\n\"\"\"\nimport struct\nimport sys\n\n# Use capstone for disassembly\ntry:\n    from capstone import *\nexcept ImportError:\n    print(\"Installing capstone...\")\n    import subprocess\n    subprocess.run([sys.executable, \"-m\", \"pip\", \"install\", \"capstone\"])\n    from capstone import *\n\nsys.stdout = open('item_handler_disasm.txt', 'w')\n\n# File offset = Ghidra address + 0x3200\nOFFSET = 0x3200\n\nwith open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    data = f.read()\n\nmd = Cs(CS_ARCH_X86, CS_MODE_32)\nmd.detail = True\n\nprint('=' * 80)\nprint('ITEM 95 HANDLER DISASSEMBLY (CD Player / Soundtrack)')\nprint('=' * 80)\nprint(f'Handler at Ghidra 0x146f4')\nprint()\n\n# Read 500 bytes of code starting at the handler\nhandler_95_offset = 0x146f4 + OFFSET\ncode_95 = data[handler_95_offset:handler_95_offset + 500]\n\nfor instr in md.disasm(code_95, 0x146f4):\n    print(f'  0x{instr.address:05x}: {instr.mnemonic:8s} {instr.op_str}')\n    # Stop at a RET instruction for initial pass\n    if instr.mnemonic.lower() == 'ret':\n        break\n\nprint()\nprint('=' * 80)\nprint('ITEM 96 HANDLER DISASSEMBLY (Background Book)')\nprint('=' * 80)\nprint(f'Handler at Ghidra 0x14ed7')\nprint()\n\n# Read 1000 bytes of code starting at the handler\nhandler_96_offset = 0x14ed7 + OFFSET\ncode_96 = data[handler_96_offset:handler_96_offset + 1000]\n\nret_count = 0\nfor instr in md.disasm(code_96, 0x14ed7):\n    print(f'  0x{instr.address:05x}: {instr.mnemonic:8s} {instr.op_str}')\n    # Stop after seeing a few rets or at max 100 instructions\n    if instr.mnemonic.lower() == 'ret':\n        ret_count += 1\n        if ret_count &gt;= 2:\n            break\n\nprint()\nprint('=' * 80)\nprint('LOOKING FOR MAIN HANDLER LOGIC')\nprint('=' * 80)\n\n# The actual handler for item 95 should do something interesting\n# Let me look at what's BEFORE 0x146f4 to understand context\nprint('\\nCode BEFORE item 95 handler (0x146d0-0x14704):')\npre_offset = 0x146d0 + OFFSET\npre_code = data[pre_offset:pre_offset + 100]\n\nfor instr in md.disasm(pre_code, 0x146d0):\n    print(f'  0x{instr.address:05x}: {instr.mnemonic:8s} {instr.op_str}')\n    if instr.address &gt; 0x14704:\n        break\n\nsys.stdout.close()\n",

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nDebug: Compare bytes at known addresses to verify offset.\n\"\"\"\nimport sys\n\nsys.stdout = open('offset_debug.txt', 'w')\n\nwith open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    data = f.read()\n\n# From Ghidra disassembly of setup_action_menu_icons at 0x14622:\n# 00014622: PUSH 0x1c \n# This should be: 6A 1C (PUSH imm8)\n\n# Calculate file offset\n# If file_offset = ghidra_addr + 0x3200:\nghidra_addr = 0x14622\nfile_offset_v1 = ghidra_addr + 0x3200  # = 0x17822\n\nprint(f'Testing address 0x{ghidra_addr:x} (setup_action_menu_icons)')\nprint(f'Expected: PUSH 0x1C =&gt; bytes: 6A 1C')\nprint()\n\n# Try various offsets\nfor offset in [0x3200, 0x3000, 0x2E00, 0x2C00, 0x2A00, -0x3200, 0]:\n    file_off = ghidra_addr + offset\n    if 0 &lt;= file_off &lt; len(data) - 10:\n        bytes_at = data[file_off:file_off + 10]\n        print(f'Offset {offset:+5x}: file 0x{file_off:05x} = {bytes_at[:6].hex()}')\n        if bytes_at[0:2] == b'\\x6a\\x1c':\n            print(f'  *** MATCH! Push 0x1C found at offset {offset:+x} ***')\n\nprint()\nprint('=' * 60)\n\n# Also try looking for the known string and calculating from there\nsearch = b\"Tic-Tac-Toe 1995\"\npos = data.find(search)\nif pos != -1:\n    print(f'String \"Tic-Tac-Toe 1995\" at file offset 0x{pos:x}')\n    print(f'Ghidra address should be: 0x49590')\n    actual_offset = pos - 0x49590\n    print(f'Calculated offset (file - ghidra): {actual_offset:+x}')\n    \n    # Now try to find setup_action_menu_icons\n    test_addr = 0x14622\n    test_file = test_addr + actual_offset\n    if 0 &lt;= test_file &lt; len(data) - 10:\n        test_bytes = data[test_file:test_file + 10]\n        print(f'\\nAt ghidra 0x{test_addr:x} + {actual_offset:+x} = file 0x{test_file:x}:')\n        print(f'  Bytes: {test_bytes[:10].hex()}')\n        if test_bytes[0:2] == b'\\x6a\\x1c':\n            print(f'  MATCH! This is the correct offset.')\n\nsys.stdout.close()\n",

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nDisassemble the code at the handler addresses for items 95 and 96.\nUsing capstone for disassembly.\n\"\"\"\nfrom capstone import *\nimport struct\n\n# File-to-Ghidra offset is 0x3200\nOFFSET = 0x3200\n\nwith open('/Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    exe_data = f.read()\n\n# Create Capstone disassembler for x86 32-bit\nmd = Cs(CS_ARCH_X86, CS_MODE_32)\n\ndef disasm_at(ghidra_addr, length=200, title=\"\"):\n    file_offset = ghidra_addr + OFFSET\n    code = exe_data[file_offset:file_offset+length]\n    print(f\"\\n{'=' * 70}\")\n    print(f\"{title}\")\n    print(f\"Ghidra address: 0x{ghidra_addr:08x}\")\n    print(f\"File offset: 0x{file_offset:08x}\")\n    print(f\"{'=' * 70}\")\n    \n    for i in md.disasm(code, ghidra_addr):\n        print(f\"0x{i.address:08x}:  {i.mnemonic:&lt;8s} {i.op_str}\")\n        if i.mnemonic == 'ret' or i.mnemonic == 'retn':\n            print(\"--- RET found ---\")\n            break\n\n# Item 95 handler\ndisasm_at(0x146f4, 400, \"ITEM 95 HANDLER (CD Player/Soundtrack)\")\n\n# Item 96 handler\ndisasm_at(0x14ed7, 400, \"ITEM 96 HANDLER (Background Book)\")\n\n# Also check if there's a function boundary just before these addresses\nprint(\"\\n\\n\")\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\nprint(\"CHECKING FOR FUNCTION BOUNDARIES NEAR ITEM 95 HANDLER\")\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\n\n# Check the instruction right before 0x146f4\ndisasm_at(0x146f0, 20, \"Just before 0x146f4\")\n\nprint(\"\\n\")\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\nprint(\"CHECKING FOR FUNCTION BOUNDARIES NEAR ITEM 96 HANDLER\")\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\n\n# Check the instruction right before 0x14ed7\ndisasm_at(0x14ed0, 20, \"Just before 0x14ed7\")\n",

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nVerify file-to-Ghidra mapping by finding a known string.\n\"\"\"\nimport struct\n\nwith open('/Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    data = f.read()\n\n# Find \"sonidos.dat\" in file\nsonidos = b\"sonidos.dat\"\nfile_pos = data.find(sonidos)\nprint(f\"'sonidos.dat' at file offset: 0x{file_pos:x}\")\n\n# Ghidra shows this string at 0x40005\nghidra_pos = 0x40005\noffset = ghidra_pos - file_pos\nprint(f\"Ghidra address: 0x{ghidra_pos:x}\")\nprint(f\"Offset (Ghidra - File): 0x{offset:x}\")\nprint()\n\n# So: Ghidra = File + offset  =&gt; Ghidra = File - 0x3200\n# Or: File = Ghidra + 0x3200\n\nprint(\"Mapping: File = Ghidra + 0x3200\")\nprint(\"Or: Ghidra = File - 0x3200\")\nprint()\n\n# Now verify with the table\n# Table at Ghidra 0x48118 should be at File 0x4b318\nprint(\"Table at Ghidra 0x48118 = File 0x{:x}\".format(0x48118 + 0x3200))\nprint()\n\n# Check what's at File 0x4b318\nprint(\"First entry at File 0x4b318:\")\nentry = data[0x4b318:0x4b320]\nitem1, item2, handler = struct.unpack('&lt;HHI', entry)\nprint(f\"  item1={item1}, item2={item2}, handler=0x{handler:x}\")\nprint()\n\n# This matches! Entry 0 has item1=281 (0x119)\n\n# Now check if the handler address IS a Ghidra address\n# Handler for entry 0: 0x127b2\n# This should be code at File offset 0x127b2 + 0x3200 = 0x159b2\nprint(\"Entry 0 handler: Ghidra 0x127b2 = File 0x{:x}\".format(0x127b2 + 0x3200))\nprint(\"Bytes at file 0x159b2:\")\nprint(' '.join(f'{data[0x159b2 + i]:02x}' for i in range(16)))\nprint()\n\n# Check Ghidra's show_action_menu_popup which starts at 0x124ad\nprint(\"show_action_menu_popup starts at Ghidra 0x124ad = File 0x{:x}\".format(0x124ad + 0x3200))\nprint(\"Bytes at file 0x156ad:\")\nprint(' '.join(f'{data[0x156ad + i]:02x}' for i in range(16)))\nprint()\n\n# Now let's check if 0x127b2 is INSIDE show_action_menu_popup\n# show_action_menu_popup: Ghidra 0x124ad - ???\n\n# The issue is that the handler addresses ARE correct Ghidra addresses\n# But they point to the MIDDLE of functions\n\n# Let me check the actual code at Ghidra 0x127b2 by looking at file 0x159b2\n# This should be valid x86 code if it's a proper entry point\nprint(\"=\" * 60)\nprint(\"CHECKING IF HANDLER 0 IS VALID CODE\")\nprint(\"=\" * 60)\n\nfrom capstone import *\nmd = Cs(CS_ARCH_X86, CS_MODE_32)\n\ncode = data[0x159b2:0x159b2 + 100]\nprint(\"Disassembly at File 0x159b2 (Ghidra 0x127b2):\")\ncount = 0\nfor instr in md.disasm(code, 0x127b2):\n    print(f\"  0x{instr.address:08x}: {instr.mnemonic:8s} {instr.op_str}\")\n    count += 1\n    if count &gt;= 20:\n        break\n\nprint()\nprint(\"=\" * 60)\nprint(\"CHECKING ITEM 95 HANDLER\")\nprint(\"=\" * 60)\n\n# Item 95 handler: Ghidra 0x146f4 = File 0x178f4\ncode = data[0x178f4:0x178f4 + 100]\nprint(\"Disassembly at File 0x178f4 (Ghidra 0x146f4):\")\ncount = 0\nfor instr in md.disasm(code, 0x146f4):\n    print(f\"  0x{instr.address:08x}: {instr.mnemonic:8s} {instr.op_str}\")\n    count += 1\n    if count &gt;= 20:\n        break\n",

{
  "invocationMessage": "Creating [](file:///Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/analyze_item95_96_table.py)",
  "pastTenseMessage": "Created [](file:///Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/analyze_item95_96_table.py)",
  "isConfirmed": {
    "type": 1
  },
  "content": "",
  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Analyze item combination table entries for items 95 and 96.\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\ndef main():\n    # Read JUEGO.EXE\n    with open('/Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n        data = f.read()\n\n    # Ghidra address 0x48118 -&gt; File offset = 0x48118 + 0x3200 = 0x4b318\n    table_file_offset = 0x4b318\n    entry_size = 8\n\n    print('Item Combination Table at file offset 0x{:X} (Ghidra 0x48118)'.format(table_file_offset))\n    print('=' * 70)\n\n    # Read all entries until we hit the end marker\n    all_entries = []\n    for entry_idx in range(100):  # Max 100 entries\n        offset = table_file_offset + entry_idx * entry_size\n        entry_data = data[offset:offset + entry_size]\n        \n        if len(entry_data) &lt; 8:\n            print('Entry {}: End of data'.format(entry_idx))\n            break\n        \n        item1, item2, handler = struct.unpack('&lt;HHI', entry_data)\n        all_entries.append((entry_idx, item1, item2, handler, offset))\n        \n        if item1 == 0xFFFF:\n            break\n\n    # Print all entries with markers for important ones\n    for entry_idx, item1, item2, handler, offset in all_entries:\n        marker = ''\n        if item1 == 95 or item2 == 95:\n            marker = ' &lt;-- ITEM 95 (CD Player)'\n        elif item1 == 96 or item2 == 96:\n            marker = ' &lt;-- ITEM 96 (Background Book)'\n        elif item1 == 0xFFFF:\n            marker = ' &lt;-- END MARKER'\n        \n        print('Entry {:2d} @ 0x{:05X}: item1={:3d} (0x{:02X}), item2={:3d} (0x{:02X}), handler=0x{:05X}{}'.format(\n            entry_idx, offset, item1, item1, item2, item2, handler, marker))\n\n    print()\n    print('=' * 70)\n    print('Total entries: {}'.format(len(all_entries)))\n\n    # Now let's look at the handler addresses more carefully\n    print()\n    print('Analyzing handler addresses for items 95 and 96:')\n    print('-' * 70)\n    \n    for entry_idx, item1, item2, handler, offset in all_entries:\n        if item1 in [95, 96] or item2 in [95, 96]:\n            print()\n            print('Entry {}: item1={}, item2={}, handler=0x{:05X}'.format(\n                entry_idx, item1, item2, handler))\n            \n            # Handler is a Ghidra address, convert to file offset\n            handler_file_offset = handler + 0x3200\n            \n            print('  Handler Ghidra addr: 0x{:05X}'.format(handler))\n            print('  Handler file offset: 0x{:05X}'.format(handler_file_offset))\n            \n            if handler_file_offset &lt; len(data):\n                handler_bytes = data[handler_file_offset:handler_file_offset + 16]\n                print('  First 16 bytes at handler:')\n                print('    Hex: {}'.format(' '.join('{:02X}'.format(b) for b in handler_bytes)))\n            else:\n                print('  ERROR: Handler offset 0x{:X} beyond file size 0x{:X}'.format(\n                    handler_file_offset, len(data)))\n\n    # Let's also check what Ghidra thinks is at those addresses\n    print()\n    print('=' * 70)\n    print('Checking for patterns in handler addresses:')\n    print()\n    \n    # Collect all unique handlers\n    handlers = set()\n    for entry_idx, item1, item2, handler, offset in all_entries:\n        if item1 != 0xFFFF:\n            handlers.add(handler)\n    \n    handlers = sorted(handlers)\n    print('Unique handler addresses:')\n    for h in handlers:\n        print('  0x{:05X}'.format(h))\n\nif __name__ == '__main__':\n    main()\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Find the item combination table and extract entries for items 95 and 96.\"\"\"\nimport struct\n\nwith open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    data = f.read()\n\n# Find a known string to calibrate the offset\npos = data.find(b'Tic-Tac-Toe 1995')\nprint(f\"Found 'Tic-Tac-Toe 1995' at file 0x{pos:X}\")\nprint(f\"Ghidra shows it at 0x49590\")\noffset = pos - 0x49590\nprint(f\"Offset (file - ghidra): 0x{offset:X} = {offset}\")\n\n# Now read the table at Ghidra 0x48118\ntable_ghidra = 0x48118\ntable_file = table_ghidra + offset\nprint(f\"\\nTable at Ghidra 0x{table_ghidra:X} = File 0x{table_file:X}\")\n\n# Read table entries\nprint(\"\\n=== ITEM COMBINATION TABLE ===\")\nprint(\"Entry | Item1 | Item2 | Handler\")\nprint(\"-\" * 45)\n\nfor i in range(100):  # Read up to 100 entries\n    entry_offset = table_file + (i * 8)\n    if entry_offset + 8 &gt; len(data):\n        break\n    \n    item1, item2, handler = struct.unpack('&lt;HHI', data[entry_offset:entry_offset+8])\n    \n    if item1 == 0xFFFF:  # End marker\n        print(f\"  {i:3} | END MARKER\")\n        break\n    \n    # Highlight items 95 and 96\n    marker = \"\"\n    if item1 == 95 or item2 == 95:\n        marker = \" &lt;-- ITEM 95 (CD Player)\"\n    elif item1 == 96 or item2 == 96:\n        marker = \" &lt;-- ITEM 96 (Background Book)\"\n    \n    print(f\"  {i:3} |  {item1:3}  |  {item2:3}  | 0x{handler:08X}{marker}\")\n\nprint(\"\\n=== ANALYSIS ===\")\nprint(\"Searching for entries with items 95 and 96...\")\n\n# Find all entries with items 95 or 96\nfor i in range(100):\n    entry_offset = table_file + (i * 8)\n    if entry_offset + 8 &gt; len(data):\n        break\n    \n    item1, item2, handler = struct.unpack('&lt;HHI', data[entry_offset:entry_offset+8])\n    \n    if item1 == 0xFFFF:\n        break\n    \n    if item1 == 95 or item2 == 95 or item1 == 96 or item2 == 96:\n        print(f\"\\nEntry {i}:\")\n        print(f\"  Item1: {item1}, Item2: {item2}\")\n        print(f\"  Handler Ghidra address: 0x{handler:08X}\")\n        print(f\"  Handler file offset: 0x{handler + offset:08X}\")\n        \n        # Read some bytes at the handler address to see what's there\n        handler_file = handler + offset\n        if 0 &lt;= handler_file &lt; len(data) - 16:\n            handler_bytes = data[handler_file:handler_file+16]\n            print(f\"  Handler bytes: {handler_bytes.hex()}\")\n",

ghidra1\nprint(f\"Method 1: 'Tic-Tac-Toe 1995' at file 0x{pos1:X}, ghidra 0x{ghidra1:X}\")\nprint(f\"  Offset: {offset1} (0x{offset1:X})\")\n\n# Method 2: Search for another known string\nstrings_to_find = [\n    (b'No sound', 0x40dac),  # from the data items list\n    (b'Detected:', 0x40ec0),\n    (b'VOC00000.WAV', 0x40f34),\n]\n\nfor s, expected_ghidra in strings_to_find:\n    pos = data.find(s)\n    if pos &gt;= 0:\n        offset = pos - expected_ghidra\n        print(f\"\\nMethod: '{s.decode()}' at file 0x{pos:X}, expected ghidra 0x{expected_ghidra:X}\")\n        print(f\"  Offset: {offset} (0x{offset:X})\")\n\n# Let's check what a known function looks like\n# From Ghidra, get_current_room_number should have a specific signature\n# Let's look for common function patterns\n\nprint(\"\\n\\nLooking for DOS4GW/Watcom executable structure...\")\nprint(f\"File starts with: {data[:2]}\")  # MZ header\n\n# Check MZ header\nif data[:2] == b'MZ':\n    # DOS MZ header\n    last_page_bytes = struct.unpack('&lt;H', data[2:4])[0]\n    total_pages = struct.unpack('&lt;H', data[4:6])[0]\n    header_paragraphs = struct.unpack('&lt;H', data[8:10])[0]\n    header_size = header_paragraphs * 16\n    \n    print(f\"MZ header size: {header_size} bytes (0x{header_size:X})\")\n    print(f\"Total pages: {total_pages}\")\n    \n    # The actual code/data starts after the header\n    # For DOS4GW, there's often a stub loader\n    \n    # Check for LE (Linear Executable) or other protected mode format\n    # LE header offset is at 0x3C in PE/LE files\n    le_offset = struct.unpack('&lt;I', data[0x3C:0x40])[0]\n    print(f\"PE/LE header offset field: 0x{le_offset:X}\")\n    \n    if le_offset &lt; len(data) - 2:\n        sig = data[le_offset:le_offset+2]\n        print(f\"Signature at offset 0x{le_offset:X}: {sig}\")\n        if sig == b'LE':\n            print(\"This is a Linear Executable (LE) - DOS4GW format\")\n\n# The key insight: Ghidra may have loaded the file with a specific base address\n# Let's try to find where the code actually starts\n\n# Search for the beginning of actual 32-bit code\n# A common pattern is PUSH EBP; MOV EBP, ESP (0x55, 0x89, 0xE5)\npatterns = [\n    (b'\\x55\\x89\\xe5', 'PUSH EBP; MOV EBP,ESP'),\n    (b'\\x55\\x8b\\xec', 'PUSH EBP; MOV EBP,ESP (alt)'),\n]\n\nprint(\"\\n\\nSearching for function prologues...\")\nfor pattern, desc in patterns:\n    pos = data.find(pattern)\n    if pos &gt;= 0:\n        print(f\"First '{desc}' at file 0x{pos:X}\")\n\n# Now let's check entry 0 handler more carefully\n# Handler is 0x127b2, which should be a valid function\nghidra_handler = 0x127b2\n\n# Try different offsets\nprint(\"\\n\\nTrying different offsets for handler 0x127b2:\")\nfor test_offset in [0x3200, 0x3000, 0x2E00, 0x2C00, 0x3400, 0x0, 0x1000, 0x2000]:\n    file_pos = ghidra_handler + test_offset\n    if file_pos &lt; len(data) - 4:\n        bytes_at = data[file_pos:file_pos+4]\n        # Check if it looks like a function start\n        if bytes_at[0] == 0x55 or bytes_at[0:2] == b'\\x68':  # PUSH EBP or PUSH imm32\n            print(f\"  Offset 0x{test_offset:X}: file 0x{file_pos:X} -&gt; {bytes_at.hex()} &lt;- POSSIBLE FUNCTION START\")\n        else:\n            print(f\"  Offset 0x{test_offset:X}: file 0x{file_pos:X} -&gt; {bytes_at.hex()}\")\n",

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Parse the LE (Linear Executable) header to understand segment layout.\"\"\"\nimport struct\n\nwith open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    data = f.read()\n\n# LE header is at offset 0x2A50\nle_offset = 0x2A50\nprint(f\"LE header at file offset 0x{le_offset:X}\")\n\n# LE header structure (key fields)\n# 0x00: 'LE' signature\n# 0x18: Number of memory pages\n# 0x1C: Initial EIP\n# 0x20: Initial ESP\n# 0x24: Memory page size\n# 0x2C: Object table offset (from LE header start)\n# 0x30: Number of objects (segments)\n# 0x44: Object page table offset\n# 0x68: Data pages offset (from file start)\n\nsig = data[le_offset:le_offset+2]\nprint(f\"Signature: {sig}\")\n\nbyte_order = struct.unpack('&lt;B', data[le_offset+2:le_offset+3])[0]\nword_order = struct.unpack('&lt;B', data[le_offset+3:le_offset+4])[0]\nprint(f\"Byte order: {byte_order}, Word order: {word_order}\")\n\nmemory_pages = struct.unpack('&lt;I', data[le_offset+0x18:le_offset+0x1C])[0]\ninitial_eip = struct.unpack('&lt;I', data[le_offset+0x1C:le_offset+0x20])[0]\ninitial_esp = struct.unpack('&lt;I', data[le_offset+0x20:le_offset+0x24])[0]\npage_size = struct.unpack('&lt;I', data[le_offset+0x24:le_offset+0x28])[0]\n\nprint(f\"\\nMemory pages: {memory_pages}\")\nprint(f\"Initial EIP: 0x{initial_eip:X}\")\nprint(f\"Initial ESP: 0x{initial_esp:X}\")\nprint(f\"Page size: {page_size}\")\n\nobject_table_offset = struct.unpack('&lt;I', data[le_offset+0x2C:le_offset+0x30])[0]\nnum_objects = struct.unpack('&lt;I', data[le_offset+0x30:le_offset+0x34])[0]\nobject_page_table_offset = struct.unpack('&lt;I', data[le_offset+0x44:le_offset+0x48])[0]\ndata_pages_offset = struct.unpack('&lt;I', data[le_offset+0x68:le_offset+0x6C])[0]\n\nprint(f\"\\nObject table offset (from LE): 0x{object_table_offset:X}\")\nprint(f\"Number of objects: {num_objects}\")\nprint(f\"Object page table offset (from LE): 0x{object_page_table_offset:X}\")\nprint(f\"Data pages offset (from file): 0x{data_pages_offset:X}\")\n\n# Read object table\nobj_table_file = le_offset + object_table_offset\nprint(f\"\\n=== OBJECT TABLE at file 0x{obj_table_file:X} ===\")\n\n# Each object entry is 24 bytes:\n# 0x00: Virtual size (4 bytes)\n# 0x04: Reloc base address (4 bytes)\n# 0x08: Object flags (4 bytes)\n# 0x0C: Page map index (4 bytes)\n# 0x10: Page map entries (4 bytes)\n# 0x14: Reserved (4 bytes)\n\nfor i in range(num_objects):\n    obj_offset = obj_table_file + i * 24\n    virtual_size = struct.unpack('&lt;I', data[obj_offset:obj_offset+4])[0]\n    reloc_base = struct.unpack('&lt;I', data[obj_offset+4:obj_offset+8])[0]\n    obj_flags = struct.unpack('&lt;I', data[obj_offset+8:obj_offset+12])[0]\n    page_map_idx = struct.unpack('&lt;I', data[obj_offset+12:obj_offset+16])[0]\n    page_map_entries = struct.unpack('&lt;I', data[obj_offset+16:obj_offset+20])[0]\n    \n    print(f\"\\nObject {i+1}:\")\n    print(f\"  Virtual size: 0x{virtual_size:X} ({virtual_size} bytes)\")\n    print(f\"  Reloc base: 0x{reloc_base:X}\")\n    print(f\"  Flags: 0x{obj_flags:X}\")\n    print(f\"  Page map: index={page_map_idx}, entries={page_map_entries}\")\n    \n    # Decode flags\n    flags_str = []\n    if obj_flags &amp; 0x0001: flags_str.append(\"READABLE\")\n    if obj_flags &amp; 0x0002: flags_str.append(\"WRITABLE\")\n    if obj_flags &amp; 0x0004: flags_str.append(\"EXECUTABLE\")\n    if obj_flags &amp; 0x0010: flags_str.append(\"RESOURCE\")\n    if obj_flags &amp; 0x0020: flags_str.append(\"DISCARDABLE\")\n    if obj_flags &amp; 0x0040: flags_str.append(\"SHARED\")\n    if obj_flags &amp; 0x0100: flags_str.append(\"PRELOAD\")\n    if obj_flags &amp; 0x0200: flags_str.append(\"INVALID\")\n    if obj_flags &amp; 0x1000: flags_str.append(\"CONFORMING\")\n    if obj_flags &amp; 0x2000: flags_str.append(\"BIG/32-BIT\")\n    print(f\"  Flags decoded: {', '.join(flags_str)}\")\n\n# Now let's figure out where each object's data is in the file\nprint(\"\\n\\n=== FILE LAYOUT ===\")\n\n# Object page table\npage_table_file = le_offset + object_page_table_offset\nprint(f\"Object page table at file 0x{page_table_file:X}\")\n\n# Each page table entry is typically 4 or 8 bytes depending on format\n# Let's read a few entries\nprint(\"\\nFirst 8 page table entries:\")\nfor i in range(8):\n    entry_offset = page_table_file + i * 4  # Assuming 4-byte entries\n    if entry_offset + 4 &lt;= len(data):\n        entry = struct.unpack('&lt;I', data[entry_offset:entry_offset+4])[0]\n        print(f\"  Page {i}: 0x{entry:08X}\")\n\n# Calculate file offset for a given Ghidra address\nprint(\"\\n\\n=== ADDRESS MAPPING ===\")\n# The data pages offset tells us where actual code/data starts in the file\nprint(f\"Data pages start at file offset: 0x{data_pages_offset:X}\")\n\n# Ghidra typically loads the first object at base 0x00010000 or similar\n# But based on the string test, offset is 0x3200\n# Let's verify by checking where 'Tic-Tac-Toe' is\n\ntic_pos = data.find(b'Tic-Tac-Toe 1995')\nprint(f\"\\n'Tic-Tac-Toe 1995' at file 0x{tic_pos:X}\")\nprint(f\"Ghidra address: 0x49590\")\nprint(f\"Offset: 0x{tic_pos - 0x49590:X}\")\n\n# Now let's check a handler address\nprint(\"\\n\\nChecking handler for item 95 at Ghidra 0x146f4:\")\ntest_addr = 0x146f4\nfor offset in [0x3200, 0x0, 0x2000, 0x3000]:\n    file_pos = test_addr + offset\n    if file_pos &lt; len(data) - 16:\n        bytes_at = data[file_pos:file_pos+16]\n        print(f\"  Offset 0x{offset:04X} -&gt; file 0x{file_pos:05X}: {bytes_at[:8].hex()}\")\n",

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nVerify the item table structure by cross-referencing with known good handlers.\n\nEntry 0: item1=281, item2=2, should call show_action_menu_popup (0x127b2)\nSo the value at 0x4811c (table_base + 4) should be 0x000127b2\n\"\"\"\nimport struct\n\nwith open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    data = f.read()\n\n# We know the offset: file = ghidra + 0x3200\noffset = 0x3200\n\n# Table base at Ghidra 0x48118\ntable_ghidra = 0x48118\ntable_file = table_ghidra + offset  # 0x4B318\n\nprint(\"=== VERIFYING TABLE STRUCTURE ===\\n\")\n\n# Entry 0 should have handler at 0x4811c (ghidra)\n# This should contain the value 0x127b2 (show_action_menu_popup)\nptr_ghidra = 0x4811c\nptr_file = ptr_ghidra + offset  # 0x4B31C\n\nprint(f\"Entry 0 handler pointer location:\")\nprint(f\"  Ghidra: 0x{ptr_ghidra:X}\")\nprint(f\"  File:   0x{ptr_file:X}\")\n\n# Read what's at that location\nhandler_value = struct.unpack('&lt;I', data[ptr_file:ptr_file+4])[0]\nprint(f\"  Value:  0x{handler_value:08X}\")\nprint(f\"  Expected: 0x000127B2 (show_action_menu_popup)\")\n\nif handler_value == 0x127b2:\n    print(\"  ✓ MATCH!\")\nelse:\n    print(f\"  ✗ MISMATCH! Got 0x{handler_value:08X}\")\n    \n# Let's also verify with the actual bytes\nprint(f\"\\nRaw bytes at file 0x{ptr_file:X}: {data[ptr_file:ptr_file+4].hex()}\")\n\n# Now check entries 43 and 44\nprint(\"\\n=== ITEM 95 (Entry 43) ===\")\nentry43_file = table_file + 43 * 8\nentry43_handler_file = entry43_file + 4\n\nentry43_data = data[entry43_file:entry43_file+8]\nitem1, item2, handler = struct.unpack('&lt;HHI', entry43_data)\nprint(f\"Entry 43 at file 0x{entry43_file:X}:\")\nprint(f\"  Raw: {entry43_data.hex()}\")\nprint(f\"  Item1: {item1}, Item2: {item2}\")\nprint(f\"  Handler: 0x{handler:08X}\")\n\n# Look for what's at the handler address\nhandler_code_file = handler + offset\nprint(f\"\\nCode at handler 0x{handler:X} (file 0x{handler_code_file:X}):\")\nif 0 &lt;= handler_code_file &lt; len(data) - 16:\n    code_bytes = data[handler_code_file:handler_code_file+16]\n    print(f\"  {code_bytes.hex()}\")\n    \n    # Is this a valid function start?\n    if code_bytes[0] == 0x55:  # PUSH EBP\n        print(\"  Looks like function start (PUSH EBP)\")\n    elif code_bytes[0:2] == b'\\x68':  # PUSH imm32\n        print(\"  Looks like function start (PUSH imm32)\")\n    else:\n        print(f\"  First byte: 0x{code_bytes[0]:02X} - not typical function start\")\n\nprint(\"\\n=== ITEM 96 (Entry 44) ===\")\nentry44_file = table_file + 44 * 8\nentry44_data = data[entry44_file:entry44_file+8]\nitem1_44, item2_44, handler_44 = struct.unpack('&lt;HHI', entry44_data)\nprint(f\"Entry 44 at file 0x{entry44_file:X}:\")\nprint(f\"  Raw: {entry44_data.hex()}\")\nprint(f\"  Item1: {item1_44}, Item2: {item2_44}\")\nprint(f\"  Handler: 0x{handler_44:08X}\")\n\nhandler44_code_file = handler_44 + offset\nprint(f\"\\nCode at handler 0x{handler_44:X} (file 0x{handler44_code_file:X}):\")\nif 0 &lt;= handler44_code_file &lt; len(data) - 16:\n    code_bytes_44 = data[handler44_code_file:handler44_code_file+16]\n    print(f\"  {code_bytes_44.hex()}\")\n\n# Now let's try different offsets to find the actual code\nprint(\"\\n=== TRYING DIFFERENT OFFSETS ===\")\nfor test_offset in [0, 0x1000, 0x2000, 0x2e00, 0x3000, 0x3200, 0x3400]:\n    entry0_ptr_file = 0x4811c + test_offset\n    if entry0_ptr_file + 4 &lt;= len(data):\n        val = struct.unpack('&lt;I', data[entry0_ptr_file:entry0_ptr_file+4])[0]\n        match = \"MATCH!\" if val == 0x127b2 else \"\"\n        print(f\"Offset 0x{test_offset:04X}: value at 0x{entry0_ptr_file:X} = 0x{val:08X} {match}\")\n",

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Verify the code offset is different from data offset.\"\"\"\nimport struct\n\nwith open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    data = f.read()\n\n# From search: setup_action_menu_icons at file 0x18822, Ghidra 0x14622\ncode_offset = 0x18822 - 0x14622  # = 0x4200\ndata_offset = 0x3200  # confirmed earlier\n\nprint(\"=== OFFSET ANALYSIS ===\")\nprint(f\"Code offset: 0x{code_offset:X}\")\nprint(f\"Data offset: 0x{data_offset:X}\")\n\n# Verify code offset with the handler addresses\nprint(\"\\n=== VERIFYING ITEM 95 HANDLER (0x146f4) ===\")\nhandler_ghidra = 0x146f4\nhandler_file = handler_ghidra + code_offset  # Using CODE offset now\n\nprint(f\"Handler Ghidra: 0x{handler_ghidra:X}\")\nprint(f\"Handler File: 0x{handler_file:X}\")\n\n# Read bytes at this location\nbytes_at = data[handler_file:handler_file+16]\nprint(f\"Bytes: {bytes_at.hex()}\")\n\n# Let's also verify by checking what Ghidra shows at 0x146f0\n# Ghidra shows: CMP EAX, 0x39 = 3D 39 00 00 00\nverify_ghidra = 0x146f0\nverify_file = verify_ghidra + code_offset\nverify_bytes = data[verify_file:verify_file+10]\nprint(f\"\\nAt Ghidra 0x{verify_ghidra:X} (file 0x{verify_file:X}):\")\nprint(f\"  Bytes: {verify_bytes.hex()}\")\nprint(f\"  Expected: 3D 39 00 00 00 (CMP EAX, 0x39)\")\n\nif verify_bytes[:5] == bytes([0x3D, 0x39, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00]):\n    print(\"  ✓ MATCH!\")\nelse:\n    print(\"  ✗ No match\")\n\n# What about the table pointer values? They should point to code addresses.\n# The table is at Ghidra 0x48118 (data), so file = 0x48118 + 0x3200 = 0x4B318\nprint(\"\\n=== VERIFYING TABLE HANDLER POINTERS ===\")\ntable_file = 0x48118 + data_offset  # 0x4B318\n\n# Entry 0 handler at table_file + 4\nentry0_handler_file = table_file + 4\nentry0_handler_value = struct.unpack('&lt;I', data[entry0_handler_file:entry0_handler_file+4])[0]\nprint(f\"Entry 0 handler value: 0x{entry0_handler_value:X}\")\nprint(f\"  This is a CODE address, so file offset = 0x{entry0_handler_value + code_offset:X}\")\n\n# Check what's at that code address\ncode_at = data[entry0_handler_value + code_offset:entry0_handler_value + code_offset + 16]\nprint(f\"  Bytes at code: {code_at.hex()}\")\n\n# Entry 43 (item 95)\nentry43_file = table_file + 43 * 8\nentry43_handler_value = struct.unpack('&lt;I', data[entry43_file+4:entry43_file+8])[0]\nprint(f\"\\nEntry 43 handler value: 0x{entry43_handler_value:X}\")\nprint(f\"  Code file offset = 0x{entry43_handler_value + code_offset:X}\")\ncode43 = data[entry43_handler_value + code_offset:entry43_handler_value + code_offset + 16]\nprint(f\"  Bytes at code: {code43.hex()}\")\n\n# Entry 44 (item 96)\nentry44_file = table_file + 44 * 8\nentry44_handler_value = struct.unpack('&lt;I', data[entry44_file+4:entry44_file+8])[0]\nprint(f\"\\nEntry 44 handler value: 0x{entry44_handler_value:X}\")\nprint(f\"  Code file offset = 0x{entry44_handler_value + code_offset:X}\")\ncode44 = data[entry44_handler_value + code_offset:entry44_handler_value + code_offset + 16]\nprint(f\"  Bytes at code: {code44.hex()}\")\n",

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Find the correct code offset by searching for specific instruction sequences from Ghidra.\"\"\"\nimport struct\n\nwith open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    data = f.read()\n\n# From Ghidra disassembly at setup_action_menu_icons 0x14622:\n# 00014622: PUSH 0x1c         -&gt; 68 1c 00 00 00\n# 00014627: CALL 0x0002a218   -&gt; E8 xx xx xx xx (relative call)\n# 0001462c: PUSH EBX          -&gt; 53\n# 0001462d: PUSH ECX          -&gt; 51\n# 0001462e: PUSH EDX          -&gt; 52\n# 0001462f: PUSH ESI          -&gt; 56\n# 00014630: PUSH EDI          -&gt; 57\n\n# The PUSH sequence 53 51 52 56 57 is distinctive\npush_sequence = bytes([0x53, 0x51, 0x52, 0x56, 0x57])\n\nprint(\"Searching for PUSH EBX; PUSH ECX; PUSH EDX; PUSH ESI; PUSH EDI (53 51 52 56 57)...\")\npositions = []\npos = 0\nwhile True:\n    pos = data.find(push_sequence, pos)\n    if pos &lt; 0:\n        break\n    # Check if preceded by PUSH 0x1C (5 bytes) and CALL (5 bytes)\n    if pos &gt;= 10:\n        prev = data[pos-10:pos]\n        if prev[0] == 0x68 and prev[5] == 0xE8:  # PUSH imm32, CALL\n            positions.append(pos - 10)\n    pos += 1\n\nprint(f\"Found {len(positions)} potential setup_action_menu_icons:\")\nfor p in positions:\n    bytes_at = data[p:p+15]\n    print(f\"  File 0x{p:X}: {bytes_at.hex()}\")\n    \n# The correct one should give us offset such that:\n# file_offset - ghidra_address = code_offset\n# For setup_action_menu_icons: file - 0x14622 = code_offset\n\nfor p in positions:\n    calc_offset = p - 0x14622\n    print(f\"\\n  If this is setup_action_menu_icons at 0x14622:\")\n    print(f\"    Code offset would be: 0x{calc_offset:X}\")\n    \n    # Verify by checking entry 0 handler (show_action_menu_popup at 0x127b2)\n    entry0_file = 0x127b2 + calc_offset\n    if 0 &lt;= entry0_file &lt; len(data):\n        bytes_e0 = data[entry0_file:entry0_file+10]\n        print(f\"    Entry 0 handler bytes: {bytes_e0.hex()}\")\n        \n# Also let's search for the exact sequence at address 0x146dd based on Ghidra:\n# 000146dd: XOR EAX,EAX    -&gt; 31 C0 (or 33 C0)\n# 000146df: MOV AX,[0x0004fba0] -&gt; 66 A1 A0 FB 04 00\n\nprint(\"\\n\\nSearching for '66 A1 A0 FB 04 00' (MOV AX,[0x4fba0])...\")\nmov_pattern = bytes([0x66, 0xA1, 0xA0, 0xFB, 0x04, 0x00])\npos = data.find(mov_pattern)\nif pos &gt;= 0:\n    print(f\"Found at file 0x{pos:X}\")\n    # This should be at Ghidra 0x146df\n    calc_offset = pos - 0x146df\n    print(f\"  If at Ghidra 0x146df, code offset = 0x{calc_offset:X}\")\n    \n    # Verify the handler for item 95\n    handler95_file = 0x146f4 + calc_offset\n    print(f\"  Item 95 handler bytes at file 0x{handler95_file:X}: {data[handler95_file:handler95_file+16].hex()}\")\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Analyze item 95 and 96 table entries in detail\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\nexe_path = '/Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/files/JUEGO.EXE'\noutput_path = '/Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/item95_96_raw.txt'\n\nlines = []\n\nwith open(exe_path, 'rb') as f:\n    # Table at Ghidra 0x48118, file offset = 0x4b318\n    table_file_offset = 0x48118 - 0x40000 + 0x43200  # = 0x4b318\n    \n    # Read raw bytes for entries 42, 43, 44\n    for entry_num in [42, 43, 44]:\n        entry_offset = table_file_offset + entry_num * 8\n        f.seek(entry_offset)\n        raw_bytes = f.read(8)\n        \n        item1, item2, handler = struct.unpack('&lt;HHI', raw_bytes)\n        hex_bytes = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in raw_bytes)\n        \n        lines.append(f\"Entry {entry_num} at file offset 0x{entry_offset:x}:\")\n        lines.append(f\"  Raw bytes: {hex_bytes}\")\n        lines.append(f\"  item1={item1} (0x{item1:04x})\")\n        lines.append(f\"  item2={item2} (0x{item2:04x})\")\n        lines.append(f\"  handler=0x{handler:08x}\")\n        lines.append(\"\")\n    \n    # Now let's check if these handlers are valid code addresses\n    # Code segment: file_offset = code_addr - 0x10000 + 0x14200\n    lines.append(\"=== CHECKING HANDLER CODE ===\")\n    for entry_num, handler in [(43, 0x146f4), (44, 0x14ed7)]:\n        code_file_offset = handler - 0x10000 + 0x14200\n        f.seek(code_file_offset)\n        code_bytes = f.read(32)\n        hex_bytes = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in code_bytes)\n        \n        lines.append(f\"Entry {entry_num} handler 0x{handler:x} at file offset 0x{code_file_offset:x}:\")\n        lines.append(f\"  Bytes: {hex_bytes}\")\n        lines.append(\"\")\n\nwith open(output_path, 'w') as f:\n    f.write('\\n'.join(lines))\n    \nprint(f\"Output written to {output_path}\")\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Verify code offset by checking known function bytes\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\nexe_path = '/Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/files/JUEGO.EXE'\noutput_path = '/Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/code_offset_verify.txt'\n\nlines = []\n\n# Known functions from Ghidra:\n# setup_action_menu_icons at 0x14622 - should start with PUSH 0x1c (68 1c 00 00 00)\n# init_memory_buffers at 0x14bd0 - also should start with a PUSH\n\nknown_funcs = [\n    (\"setup_action_menu_icons\", 0x14622, b'\\x68\\x1c\\x00\\x00\\x00'),  # PUSH 0x1c\n    (\"init_memory_buffers\", 0x14bd0, None),  # unknown start\n    (\"load_fonts_and_graphics\", 0x14ee3, None),\n]\n\nwith open(exe_path, 'rb') as f:\n    for name, ghidra_addr, expected in known_funcs:\n        # Try different offset calculations\n        offsets = [\n            (\"code_offset = addr - 0x10000 + 0x14200\", ghidra_addr - 0x10000 + 0x14200),\n            (\"code_offset = addr - 0x10000 + 0x13200\", ghidra_addr - 0x10000 + 0x13200),\n            (\"code_offset = addr + 0x3200\", ghidra_addr + 0x3200),\n            (\"code_offset = addr + 0x4200\", ghidra_addr + 0x4200),\n        ]\n        \n        lines.append(f\"=== {name} at Ghidra 0x{ghidra_addr:x} ===\")\n        \n        for desc, file_offset in offsets:\n            if file_offset &lt; 0 or file_offset &gt; 0x100000:\n                continue\n            f.seek(file_offset)\n            bytes_read = f.read(16)\n            hex_str = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in bytes_read)\n            \n            match = \"\"\n            if expected and bytes_read[:len(expected)] == expected:\n                match = \" &lt;-- MATCHES!\"\n            \n            lines.append(f\"  {desc}:\")\n            lines.append(f\"    file_offset=0x{file_offset:x}, bytes: {hex_str}{match}\")\n        \n        lines.append(\"\")\n\nwith open(output_path, 'w') as f:\n    f.write('\\n'.join(lines))\n    \nprint(f\"Output written to {output_path}\")\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

  "content": "",
  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Analyze callers of process_inventory_action\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\nexe_path = '/Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/files/JUEGO.EXE'\noutput_path = '/Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/inventory_callers.txt'\n\nlines = []\n\n# The xrefs to process_inventory_action:\n# From 00018644 in execute_room_specific_script [UNCONDITIONAL_CALL]\n# From 0002280c [UNCONDITIONAL_CALL]\n# From 00022837 [UNCONDITIONAL_CALL]\n# From 00022e6e [UNCONDITIONAL_CALL]\n\ncallers = [\n    (0x2280c, \"caller 1\"),\n    (0x22837, \"caller 2\"),\n    (0x22e6e, \"caller 3\"),\n]\n\nwith open(exe_path, 'rb') as f:\n    for addr, name in callers:\n        # Code offset: file = ghidra - 0x10000 + 0x14200\n        file_offset = addr - 0x10000 + 0x14200\n        \n        # Read context around the call\n        f.seek(file_offset - 32)\n        context = f.read(64)\n        \n        lines.append(f\"=== {name} at 0x{addr:x} ===\")\n        for i in range(0, 64, 16):\n            offset = addr - 32 + i\n            hex_str = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in context[i:i+16])\n            marker = \" &lt;-- CALL\" if i == 32 else \"\"\n            lines.append(f\"  {offset:05x}: {hex_str}{marker}\")\n        \n        # Look for item ID being pushed before the call\n        # Common pattern: MOV EAX, &lt;item_id&gt;; CALL process_inventory_action\n        # or: PUSH &lt;item_id&gt;; CALL ...\n        lines.append(\"\")\n        \n        # Check if 0x5f (95) or 0x60 (96) appear nearby\n        context_all = f.read(128)\n        f.seek(file_offset - 64)\n        context_all = f.read(128)\n        if 0x5f in context_all or 0x60 in context_all:\n            lines.append(\"  ** Found 0x5f (95) or 0x60 (96) nearby! **\")\n        lines.append(\"\")\n\nwith open(output_path, 'w') as f:\n    f.write('\\n'.join(lines))\n    \nprint(f\"Output written to {output_path}\")\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

  "content": "",
  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Search for item 95 (0x5f) and 96 (0x60) in code section\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\nexe_path = '/Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/files/JUEGO.EXE'\noutput_path = '/Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/search_items_95_96.txt'\n\nlines = []\n\n# Code section in file: from 0x14200 to roughly 0x56000\n# Search for patterns like:\n# MOV EAX, 0x5f:  B8 5F 00 00 00\n# MOV EAX, 0x60:  B8 60 00 00 00\n# PUSH 0x5f:      68 5F 00 00 00\n# CMP EAX, 0x5f:  3D 5F 00 00 00\n# etc.\n\npatterns = [\n    (b'\\xb8\\x5f\\x00\\x00\\x00', \"MOV EAX, 95 (0x5f)\"),\n    (b'\\xb8\\x60\\x00\\x00\\x00', \"MOV EAX, 96 (0x60)\"),\n    (b'\\x68\\x5f\\x00\\x00\\x00', \"PUSH 95 (0x5f)\"),\n    (b'\\x68\\x60\\x00\\x00\\x00', \"PUSH 96 (0x60)\"),\n    (b'\\x3d\\x5f\\x00\\x00\\x00', \"CMP EAX, 95 (0x5f)\"),\n    (b'\\x3d\\x60\\x00\\x00\\x00', \"CMP EAX, 96 (0x60)\"),\n    # 16-bit versions\n    (b'\\x66\\xb8\\x5f\\x00', \"MOV AX, 95\"),\n    (b'\\x66\\xb8\\x60\\x00', \"MOV AX, 96\"),\n]\n\nwith open(exe_path, 'rb') as f:\n    f.seek(0x14200)  # Code section start\n    code = f.read(0x42000)  # Read entire code section\n    \n    for pattern, desc in patterns:\n        lines.append(f\"=== Searching for: {desc} ===\")\n        pos = 0\n        count = 0\n        while True:\n            idx = code.find(pattern, pos)\n            if idx == -1:\n                break\n            \n            ghidra_addr = 0x10000 + idx  # Convert to Ghidra address\n            \n            # Read context\n            context_start = max(0, idx - 16)\n            context = code[context_start:idx + len(pattern) + 16]\n            hex_str = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in context)\n            \n            lines.append(f\"  Found at Ghidra 0x{ghidra_addr:05x}: {hex_str}\")\n            count += 1\n            pos = idx + len(pattern)\n        \n        if count == 0:\n            lines.append(\"  (not found)\")\n        lines.append(\"\")\n\nwith open(output_path, 'w') as f:\n    f.write('\\n'.join(lines))\n    \nprint(f\"Output written to {output_path}\")\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Analyze the found locations for items 95 and 96\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\nexe_path = '/Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/files/JUEGO.EXE'\noutput_path = '/Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/analyze_found_locations.txt'\n\nlines = []\n\n# Found locations:\n# 0x21b80: MOV EAX, 95\n# 0x21b94: MOV EAX, 96\n\nlocations = [\n    (0x21b80, \"Item 95 (CD Player)\"),\n    (0x21b94, \"Item 96 (Background Book)\"),\n    (0x1516b, \"Item 96 (alternate location)\"),\n]\n\nwith open(exe_path, 'rb') as f:\n    for ghidra_addr, desc in locations:\n        file_offset = ghidra_addr - 0x10000 + 0x14200\n        \n        lines.append(f\"=== {desc} at Ghidra 0x{ghidra_addr:x} ===\")\n        \n        # Read a larger context (128 bytes before, 64 after)\n        f.seek(file_offset - 128)\n        context = f.read(192)\n        \n        for i in range(0, 192, 16):\n            offset = ghidra_addr - 128 + i\n            hex_str = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in context[i:i+16])\n            marker = \" &lt;-- HERE\" if i == 128 else \"\"\n            lines.append(f\"  {offset:05x}: {hex_str}{marker}\")\n        \n        lines.append(\"\")\n\nwith open(output_path, 'w') as f:\n    f.write('\\n'.join(lines))\n    \nprint(f\"Output written to {output_path}\")\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Analyze the hotspot action dispatch table at 0x47bf0\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\nexe_path = '/Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/files/JUEGO.EXE'\n\n# Table at Ghidra 0x47bf0, file offset = 0x47bf0 - 0x40000 + 0x43200 = 0x4adf0\n\nwith open(exe_path, 'rb') as f:\n    table_file_offset = 0x47bf0 - 0x40000 + 0x43200\n    f.seek(table_file_offset)\n    \n    print(\"=== HOTSPOT ACTION DISPATCH TABLE (0x47bf0) ===\")\n    print(\"Entry | Extra ID | Handler\")\n    print(\"-\" * 50)\n    \n    for i in range(200):  # Read up to 200 entries\n        entry = f.read(6)\n        extra_id, handler = struct.unpack('&lt;HI', entry)\n        if extra_id == 0xFFFF:\n            print(f\"Entry {i}: END OF TABLE\")\n            break\n        print(f\"Entry {i:3d}: extra_id={extra_id:5d} (0x{extra_id:04x}), handler=0x{handler:05x}\")\n",

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Find function containing 0x21b80\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\nexe_path = '/Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/files/JUEGO.EXE'\noutput_path = '/Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/find_function.txt'\n\nlines = []\n\n# Code at 0x21b80 - search backward for function prologue\n# Common prologues: PUSH EBP (55), PUSH &lt;imm&gt; (68 xx xx xx xx)\n\nwith open(exe_path, 'rb') as f:\n    target_addr = 0x21b80\n    file_offset = target_addr - 0x10000 + 0x14200\n    \n    lines.append(f\"Target address: 0x{target_addr:x}\")\n    lines.append(f\"File offset: 0x{file_offset:x}\")\n    lines.append(\"\")\n    \n    # Read 0x1000 bytes before target\n    search_start = file_offset - 0x1000\n    f.seek(search_start)\n    code = f.read(0x1000 + 64)\n    \n    # Search for function prologues\n    prologues_found = []\n    for i in range(len(code) - 5):\n        byte = code[i]\n        addr = target_addr - 0x1000 + i\n        \n        # PUSH imm32: 68 xx xx xx xx\n        if byte == 0x68 and i + 5 &lt; len(code):\n            if code[i+5] == 0xe8:  # followed by CALL\n                prologues_found.append((addr, \"PUSH imm32; CALL\"))\n    \n    lines.append(f\"Found {len(prologues_found)} potential function starts\")\n    \n    # Show the last few (closest to target)\n    for addr, desc in prologues_found[-20:]:\n        ghidra_addr = addr\n        if ghidra_addr &lt; target_addr:\n            lines.append(f\"  0x{ghidra_addr:05x}: {desc}\")\n    \n    lines.append(\"\")\n    lines.append(\"=== CONTEXT AROUND 0x21b80 (item 95/96 code) ===\")\n    \n    # Read context at target\n    f.seek(file_offset - 0x100)\n    context = f.read(0x200)\n    \n    for i in range(0, 0x200, 16):\n        offset = target_addr - 0x100 + i\n        hex_str = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in context[i:i+16])\n        marker = \"\"\n        if i == 0x100:\n            marker = \" &lt;-- 0x21b80 (MOV EAX, 95)\"\n        elif i == 0x100 + 0x14:\n            marker = \" &lt;-- 0x21b94 (MOV EAX, 96)\"\n        lines.append(f\"  {offset:05x}: {hex_str}{marker}\")\n\nwith open(output_path, 'w') as f:\n    f.write('\\n'.join(lines))\n\nprint(f\"Output written to {output_path}\")\n",

Result:

```json
{
  "invocationMessage": "Creating [](file:///Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/search_f8_table.py)",
  "pastTenseMessage": "Created [](file:///Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/search_f8_table.py)",
  "isConfirmed": {
    "type": 1
  },
  "content": "",
  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nSearch the F8 action dispatch table for addresses containing items 95 and 96.\n\nF8 table at 0x47e58:\n- 6-byte entries: [action_id:2, handler_ptr:4]\n- Terminated by action_id = 0xFFFF\n\nWe're looking for handlers that point to:\n- 0x21b80 (item 95 grant) or nearby\n- 0x21b94 (item 96 grant) or nearby\n\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\n# Data offset formula: file_offset = ghidra_addr - 0x40000 + 0x43200\ndef data_addr_to_file(addr):\n    return addr - 0x40000 + 0x43200\n\nF8_TABLE_ADDR = 0x47e58\nF8_TABLE_FILE = data_addr_to_file(F8_TABLE_ADDR)\n\n# Target addresses (item grant code)\nITEM_95_ADDR = 0x21b80\nITEM_96_ADDR = 0x21b94\n\n# Also search for addresses in the range around these items\nSEARCH_RANGE = (0x21b00, 0x21c00)\n\nwith open(\"files/JUEGO.EXE\", \"rb\") as f:\n    f.seek(F8_TABLE_FILE)\n    \n    print(f\"F8 Action Dispatch Table at 0x{F8_TABLE_ADDR:05x} (file: 0x{F8_TABLE_FILE:05x})\")\n    print(\"=\"*70)\n    print(f\"Looking for handlers in range 0x{SEARCH_RANGE[0]:05x} - 0x{SEARCH_RANGE[1]:05x}\")\n    print(\"-\"*70)\n    \n    entry_num = 0\n    matching_entries = []\n    all_entries = []\n    \n    while True:\n        data = f.read(6)\n        if len(data) &lt; 6:\n            break\n        \n        action_id, handler = struct.unpack('&lt;HI', data)\n        \n        if action_id == 0xFFFF:\n            print(f\"\\n[End of table at entry {entry_num}]\")\n            break\n        \n        all_entries.append((action_id, handler))\n        \n        # Check if handler points to our range\n        if SEARCH_RANGE[0] &lt;= handler &lt;= SEARCH_RANGE[1]:\n            matching_entries.append((entry_num, action_id, handler))\n            print(f\"*** MATCH! Entry {entry_num}: action_id=0x{action_id:04x}, handler=0x{handler:05x}\")\n        \n        entry_num += 1\n        \n        if entry_num &gt; 2000:  # Safety limit\n            print(\"Warning: too many entries, stopping\")\n            break\n    \n    print(f\"\\nTotal entries: {entry_num}\")\n    print(f\"Matching entries: {len(matching_entries)}\")\n    \n    if matching_entries:\n        print(\"\\n\" + \"=\"*70)\n        print(\"MATCHING ENTRIES:\")\n        print(\"=\"*70)\n        for num, aid, hnd in matching_entries:\n            print(f\"  Entry {num}: action_id=0x{aid:04x} ({aid}), handler=0x{hnd:05x}\")\n    \n    # Also let's find ALL entries and look for patterns with items 95/96\n    print(\"\\n\" + \"=\"*70)\n    print(\"Looking for action IDs that might relate to items 95 (0x5F) and 96 (0x60)...\")\n    print(\"-\"*70)\n    \n    for i, (aid, hnd) in enumerate(all_entries):\n        # Look for action IDs containing 95 or 96, or that look like item-related codes\n        if aid in [95, 96, 0x5F, 0x60, 0x015F, 0x0160, 0x025F, 0x0260]:\n            print(f\"  Entry {i}: action_id=0x{aid:04x} ({aid}), handler=0x{hnd:05x}\")\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nRead raw bytes at F8 handler addresses for items 95 and 96.\nHandler for 0x015F (351) = 0x1202f\nHandler for 0x0160 (352) = 0x1151d\n\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\n# Code offset formula: file_offset = ghidra_addr - 0x10000 + 0x14200\ndef code_addr_to_file(addr):\n    return addr - 0x10000 + 0x14200\n\nHANDLERS = [\n    (0x015F, 0x1202f, \"Item 95 - CD Player/Soundtrack\"),\n    (0x0160, 0x1151d, \"Item 96 - Background Book\"),\n]\n\nwith open(\"files/JUEGO.EXE\", \"rb\") as f:\n    for action_id, handler, desc in HANDLERS:\n        file_offset = code_addr_to_file(handler)\n        print(f\"F8 Action 0x{action_id:04x}: {desc}\")\n        print(f\"  Handler address: 0x{handler:05x}\")\n        print(f\"  File offset: 0x{file_offset:05x}\")\n        \n        # Read context before and after\n        f.seek(file_offset - 16)\n        data_before = f.read(16)\n        data_at = f.read(32)\n        \n        print(f\"  Bytes before: {data_before.hex()}\")\n        print(f\"  Bytes at handler: {data_at.hex()}\")\n        \n        # Try to interpret as instructions\n        print(f\"  First bytes: \", end=\"\")\n        for i, b in enumerate(data_at[:16]):\n            print(f\"{b:02x} \", end=\"\")\n        print()\n        print()\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}
```
Status: **completed**

</tool-use>

{
  "invocationMessage": "Creating [](file:///Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/search_f8_in_rooms.py)",
  "pastTenseMessage": "Created [](file:///Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/search_f8_in_rooms.py)",
  "isConfirmed": {
    "type": 1
  },
  "content": "",
  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nSearch all room text data in ALFRED.1 for F8 codes that trigger granting items 95 and 96.\n\nF8 action format in text: F8 &lt;low_byte&gt; &lt;high_byte&gt;\nLooking for:\n- F8 5F 01 = action 0x015F (item 95 - CD Player)\n- F8 60 01 = action 0x0160 (item 96 - Background Book)\n\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\nimport os\n\n# Room directory structure - 56 rooms, 13 pairs of offset+size each\ndef load_room_text(room_num, alfred1_data):\n    \"\"\"Load text data for a room (pair 12 = entry 11 in 0-indexed)\"\"\"\n    PAIRS_PER_ROOM = 13\n    \n    # Read room directory entry\n    dir_offset = room_num * PAIRS_PER_ROOM * 8  # 8 bytes per pair (offset:4 + size:4)\n    \n    # Text is pair 12 (index 11)\n    text_pair_offset = dir_offset + 11 * 8\n    text_offset, text_size = struct.unpack_from('&lt;II', alfred1_data, text_pair_offset)\n    \n    if text_offset == 0 or text_size == 0:\n        return None\n    \n    return alfred1_data[text_offset:text_offset + text_size]\n\n# Search for F8 patterns\nTARGETS = [\n    (b'\\xf8\\x5f\\x01', 0x015F, \"Item 95 grant (CD Player/Soundtrack)\"),\n    (b'\\xf8\\x60\\x01', 0x0160, \"Item 96 grant (Background Book)\"),\n]\n\nwith open(\"files/ALFRED.1\", \"rb\") as f:\n    alfred1_data = f.read()\n\nprint(\"Searching room text data for F8 action codes...\")\nprint(\"=\"*70)\n\nfound_any = False\n\nfor room_num in range(56):\n    text_data = load_room_text(room_num, alfred1_data)\n    \n    if text_data is None:\n        continue\n    \n    for pattern, action_id, desc in TARGETS:\n        # Find all occurrences\n        start = 0\n        while True:\n            pos = text_data.find(pattern, start)\n            if pos == -1:\n                break\n            \n            found_any = True\n            \n            # Get context\n            ctx_start = max(0, pos - 20)\n            ctx_end = min(len(text_data), pos + 30)\n            context = text_data[ctx_start:ctx_end]\n            \n            print(f\"\\nRoom {room_num}: Found F8 action 0x{action_id:04x}\")\n            print(f\"  Description: {desc}\")\n            print(f\"  Offset in text: 0x{pos:04x}\")\n            print(f\"  Context bytes: {context.hex()}\")\n            \n            # Try to extract readable text around it\n            printable_context = \"\"\n            for b in context:\n                if 0x20 &lt;= b &lt; 0x7F:\n                    printable_context += chr(b)\n                elif b == 0:\n                    printable_context += \" \"\n                else:\n                    printable_context += f\"[{b:02x}]\"\n            print(f\"  Context text: {printable_context[:60]}...\")\n            \n            start = pos + 1\n\nif not found_any:\n    print(\"\\nNo F8 codes found for items 95 or 96 in room text data.\")\n    print(\"\\nLet's search for any F8 codes in rooms...\")\n    \n    # Search for any F8 code\n    for room_num in range(56):\n        text_data = load_room_text(room_num, alfred1_data)\n        if text_data is None:\n            continue\n        \n        pos = text_data.find(b'\\xf8')\n        if pos != -1:\n            print(f\"  Room {room_num}: Found F8 at offset 0x{pos:04x}\")\n            # Show the action ID\n            if pos + 2 &lt; len(text_data):\n                action_id = text_data[pos+1] | (text_data[pos+2] &lt;&lt; 8)\n                print(f\"    Action ID: 0x{action_id:04x}\")\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nFind what dispatch table contains 0x21b80 (item 95 grant) or 0x21b94 (item 96 grant).\nThese must be referenced somewhere in data tables.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\n# Search the entire data section for references to these addresses\nSEARCH_ADDRS = [\n    0x21b80,  # Item 95 grant\n    0x21b94,  # Item 96 grant\n]\n\n# Data section starts around 0x40000 in Ghidra address space\n# File offset = ghidra_addr - 0x40000 + 0x43200\nDATA_START = 0x43200  # File offset where data starts\nDATA_SIZE = 0x20000   # Search 128KB of data\n\nwith open(\"files/JUEGO.EXE\", \"rb\") as f:\n    f.seek(DATA_START)\n    data = f.read(DATA_SIZE)\n\nprint(\"Searching data section for pointers to item grant code...\")\nprint(\"=\"*70)\n\nfor target in SEARCH_ADDRS:\n    # Pack as little-endian 32-bit\n    target_bytes = struct.pack('&lt;I', target)\n    \n    print(f\"\\nSearching for 0x{target:05x} ({target_bytes.hex()})...\")\n    \n    pos = 0\n    count = 0\n    while True:\n        pos = data.find(target_bytes, pos)\n        if pos == -1:\n            break\n        \n        count += 1\n        file_offset = DATA_START + pos\n        ghidra_addr = file_offset - 0x43200 + 0x40000\n        \n        # Get context\n        ctx_start = max(0, pos - 8)\n        ctx_end = min(len(data), pos + 16)\n        context = data[ctx_start:ctx_end]\n        \n        print(f\"  Found at file offset 0x{file_offset:05x} (Ghidra 0x{ghidra_addr:05x})\")\n        print(f\"    Context: {context.hex()}\")\n        \n        # If it looks like a table entry (2 bytes before = ID, 4 bytes = ptr)\n        if pos &gt;= 2:\n            entry_id = struct.unpack_from('&lt;H', data, pos - 2)[0]\n            print(f\"    Possible table entry ID: 0x{entry_id:04x} ({entry_id})\")\n        \n        pos += 1\n    \n    print(f\"  Total matches: {count}\")\n\n# Also search the code section for references\nCODE_START = 0x14200  # File offset where code starts  \nCODE_SIZE = 0x2C000   # Search ~176KB of code\n\nwith open(\"files/JUEGO.EXE\", \"rb\") as f:\n    f.seek(CODE_START)\n    code = f.read(CODE_SIZE)\n\nprint(\"\\n\" + \"=\"*70)\nprint(\"Searching code section for references to item grant code...\")\n\nfor target in SEARCH_ADDRS:\n    target_bytes = struct.pack('&lt;I', target)\n    \n    print(f\"\\nSearching for 0x{target:05x} in code...\")\n    \n    pos = 0\n    count = 0\n    while True:\n        pos = code.find(target_bytes, pos)\n        if pos == -1:\n            break\n        \n        count += 1\n        file_offset = CODE_START + pos\n        ghidra_addr = file_offset - 0x14200 + 0x10000\n        \n        # Get context including instruction before\n        ctx_start = max(0, pos - 5)\n        ctx_end = min(len(code), pos + 10)\n        context = code[ctx_start:ctx_end]\n        \n        print(f\"  Found at file offset 0x{file_offset:05x} (Ghidra 0x{ghidra_addr:05x})\")\n        print(f\"    Context: {context.hex()}\")\n        \n        pos += 1\n    \n    print(f\"  Total matches: {count}\")\n",

  "content": "",
  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nFind the function containing 0x21b80 by looking at function boundaries.\nDisassemble from the function start to understand how we reach item 95/96 grants.\n\"\"\"\n\n# From the function list:\n# 0x1bfba = process_game_state\n# 0x1eb71 = play_dialog_sound_effect\n# 0x24157 = process_inventory_action\n# \n# 0x21b80 is between 0x1eb71 and 0x24157\n# So the function containing it should be one that starts after 0x1eb71\n\n# Let's look at functions in this range:\nFUNCTIONS = [\n    (0x1bfba, \"process_game_state\"),\n    (0x1eb71, \"play_dialog_sound_effect\"),\n    (0x24157, \"process_inventory_action\"),\n    (0x244e8, \"set_vga_palette\"),\n]\n\n# 0x21b80 is between play_dialog_sound_effect (0x1eb71) and process_inventory_action (0x24157)\n# But this is a BIG gap - 0x55E6 bytes!\n# Let me read the raw bytes to understand the structure\n\nimport struct\n\n# Code offset: file_offset = ghidra_addr - 0x10000 + 0x14200\ndef code_to_file(addr):\n    return addr - 0x10000 + 0x14200\n\n# Read around 0x21b80 and look backwards for function prologue\nTARGET = 0x21b80\nSEARCH_BACK = 0x500  # Search 1.25KB backwards\n\nwith open(\"files/JUEGO.EXE\", \"rb\") as f:\n    start_file = code_to_file(TARGET) - SEARCH_BACK\n    f.seek(start_file)\n    data = f.read(SEARCH_BACK + 0x100)\n\nprint(f\"Looking for function prologue before 0x{TARGET:05x}...\")\nprint(\"=\"*70)\n\n# Common function prologues:\n# 55 = PUSH EBP\n# 56 = PUSH ESI\n# 57 = PUSH EDI\n# 83 EC xx = SUB ESP, xx\n\n# Look for PUSH EBP; MOV EBP, ESP patterns or just PUSH sequences\npos = SEARCH_BACK  # Start at target location\nwhile pos &gt; 0:\n    pos -= 1\n    \n    # Check for common function start patterns\n    b = data[pos]\n    \n    # PUSH EBP (55) often starts functions\n    if b == 0x55:\n        ghidra_addr = TARGET - (SEARCH_BACK - pos)\n        \n        # Check if followed by MOV EBP, ESP (89 E5 or 8B EC)\n        if pos + 2 &lt; len(data):\n            next2 = data[pos+1:pos+3]\n            if next2 in [b'\\x89\\xe5', b'\\x8b\\xec']:\n                print(f\"  Possible function start at 0x{ghidra_addr:05x}: PUSH EBP; MOV EBP,ESP\")\n                # Show more context\n                print(f\"    Bytes: {data[pos:pos+10].hex()}\")\n    \n    # PUSH ESI; PUSH EDI (56 57) pattern\n    if b == 0x56 and pos + 1 &lt; len(data) and data[pos+1] == 0x57:\n        ghidra_addr = TARGET - (SEARCH_BACK - pos)\n        print(f\"  Possible function start at 0x{ghidra_addr:05x}: PUSH ESI; PUSH EDI\")\n        print(f\"    Bytes: {data[pos:pos+10].hex()}\")\n\n# Also let's look at what's at the beginning of the \"gap\" after play_dialog_sound_effect\nprint(\"\\n\" + \"=\"*70)\nprint(\"Checking code after play_dialog_sound_effect (0x1eb71)...\")\n\nFUNC_START = 0x1ec00  # A bit after the function to see what comes next\nfor offset in range(0, 0x100, 0x10):\n    addr = FUNC_START + offset\n    file_pos = code_to_file(addr)\n    with open(\"files/JUEGO.EXE\", \"rb\") as f:\n        f.seek(file_pos)\n        line = f.read(16)\n    print(f\"  0x{addr:05x}: {line.hex()}\")\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nAnalyze the jump table entries around 0x21b80 and determine where they lead.\nEach entry is: MOV EAX, item_num; JMP relative\n\nFormat: B8 XX XX XX XX E9 YY YY YY YY\n        MOV EAX, imm32  JMP rel32\n\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\n# Code offset: file_offset = ghidra_addr - 0x10000 + 0x14200\ndef code_to_file(addr):\n    return addr - 0x10000 + 0x14200\n\ndef file_to_code(file_off):\n    return file_off - 0x14200 + 0x10000\n\n# Read the jump table entries\nSTART = 0x21b50  # Start a bit before item 95\nEND = 0x21c00    # End a bit after item 96\n\nwith open(\"files/JUEGO.EXE\", \"rb\") as f:\n    f.seek(code_to_file(START))\n    data = f.read(END - START)\n\nprint(\"Analyzing jump table entries for item grant code...\")\nprint(\"=\"*70)\n\n# Parse entries - look for MOV EAX pattern\npos = 0\nwhile pos &lt; len(data) - 10:\n    # Check for MOV EAX, imm32 (B8 XX XX XX XX)\n    if data[pos] == 0xB8:\n        imm = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, pos + 1)[0]\n        \n        # Check if followed by JMP rel32 (E9 XX XX XX XX)\n        if data[pos + 5] == 0xE9:\n            rel = struct.unpack_from('&lt;i', data, pos + 6)[0]  # Signed!\n            \n            ghidra_addr = START + pos\n            jmp_target = ghidra_addr + 10 + rel  # 10 = size of MOV+JMP\n            \n            # Check if this looks like an item number (small positive)\n            if 0 &lt; imm &lt; 200:\n                print(f\"0x{ghidra_addr:05x}: MOV EAX, {imm:3d} (0x{imm:02x}); JMP 0x{jmp_target:05x}\")\n        \n        pos += 10  # Skip to next potential entry\n    else:\n        pos += 1\n\nprint(\"\\n\" + \"=\"*70)\nprint(\"The jump targets should all be process_inventory_action (0x24157)\")\nprint(\"or some similar item-adding function.\")\n\n# Now let's understand what CALLS/JUMPS to this jump table\n# Look for xrefs by searching for JMP or CALL to addresses in this range\n\nprint(\"\\n\" + \"=\"*70)\nprint(\"Looking for what dispatches to this jump table...\")\nprint()\n\n# The dispatch likely uses a computed jump based on item/action ID\n# Look for pattern: JMP [reg*4 + base_table]\n# Or: switch statement with case table\n\n# Let's check the F8 table entry again - handler 0x1202f and 0x1151d\n# These should set up some state and then jump into this table\n\nprint(\"F8 action handlers should eventually lead to this jump table:\")\nprint(\"  0x015F (Item 95) -&gt;
