  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nLook at the dispatch code BEFORE the jump table entries.\nThere should be a switch or computed jump that routes to different item grants.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\ndef code_to_file(addr):\n    return addr - 0x10000 + 0x14200\n\n# Read a larger chunk before the item 93 entry\nSTART = 0x21a00  # Start well before item 93 entry (0x21b58)\nSIZE = 0x200\n\nwith open(\"files/JUEGO.EXE\", \"rb\") as f:\n    f.seek(code_to_file(START))\n    data = f.read(SIZE)\n\nprint(\"Hex dump before the item grant jump table...\")\nprint(\"Looking for dispatch code at start of jump table block\")\nprint(\"=\"*70)\n\nfor i in range(0, SIZE, 16):\n    addr = START + i\n    line = data[i:i+16]\n    hexpart = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in line)\n    \n    # Mark important addresses\n    marker = \"\"\n    if 0x21b58 &lt;= addr &lt; 0x21b58 + 16:\n        marker = \" &lt;-- Item 93 grant\"\n    elif 0x21b80 &lt;= addr &lt; 0x21b80 + 16:\n        marker = \" &lt;-- Item 95 grant\"\n    elif 0x21b94 &lt;= addr &lt; 0x21b94 + 16:\n        marker = \" &lt;-- Item 96 grant\"\n    \n    print(f\"0x{addr:05x}: {hexpart}{marker}\")\n\nprint(\"\\n\" + \"=\"*70)\nprint(\"\\nLooking for CALL patterns that might be setting up state before grant...\")\n\n# Search for CALL/JMP patterns\nfor i in range(len(data) - 5):\n    if data[i] == 0xE8:  # CALL rel32\n        rel = struct.unpack_from('&lt;i', data, i + 1)[0]\n        target = START + i + 5 + rel\n        if 0x10000 &lt;= target &lt;= 0x40000:\n            addr = START + i\n            print(f\"  0x{addr:05x}: CALL 0x{target:05x}\")\n",

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nRead the hotspot action dispatch table at 0x47bf0 and find entries\nthat point to item 95/96 grant code.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\n# Data offset: file_offset = ghidra_addr - 0x40000 + 0x43200\ndef data_to_file(addr):\n    return addr - 0x40000 + 0x43200\n\nTABLE_ADDR = 0x47bf0\nTABLE_FILE = data_to_file(TABLE_ADDR)\n\n# Targets we're looking for\nTARGETS = {\n    0x21b80: \"Item 95 grant\",\n    0x21b94: \"Item 96 grant\",\n    0x21b58: \"Item 93 grant\",\n    0x21b6c: \"Item 94 grant\",\n}\n\n# Also look for addresses in the general unanalyzed area\nRANGE_START = 0x1ec00\nRANGE_END = 0x24157\n\nwith open(\"files/JUEGO.EXE\", \"rb\") as f:\n    f.seek(TABLE_FILE)\n    \n    print(f\"Hotspot Action Dispatch Table at 0x{TABLE_ADDR:05x}\")\n    print(\"=\"*70)\n    print(\"Format: [extra_id:2, handler:4] - 6 bytes per entry\")\n    print(\"-\"*70)\n    \n    entry_num = 0\n    found = []\n    \n    while True:\n        data = f.read(6)\n        if len(data) &lt; 6:\n            break\n        \n        extra_id, handler = struct.unpack('&lt;HI', data)\n        \n        if extra_id == 0xFFFF:\n            print(f\"\\n[End of table at entry {entry_num}]\")\n            break\n        \n        # Check if handler is in our target list\n        marker = \"\"\n        if handler in TARGETS:\n            marker = f\" &lt;== {TARGETS[handler]}\"\n            found.append((entry_num, extra_id, handler, TARGETS[handler]))\n        elif RANGE_START &lt;= handler &lt;= RANGE_END:\n            marker = f\" (in unanalyzed region)\"\n        \n        if extra_id &gt;= 0x5F and extra_id &lt;= 0x70:  # Around item 95/96 range\n            print(f\"Entry {entry_num:3d}: extra_id=0x{extra_id:04x} ({extra_id:3d}), handler=0x{handler:05x}{marker}\")\n        elif marker:\n            print(f\"Entry {entry_num:3d}: extra_id=0x{extra_id:04x} ({extra_id:3d}), handler=0x{handler:05x}{marker}\")\n        \n        entry_num += 1\n        \n        if entry_num &gt; 500:\n            print(\"Warning: table too large, stopping\")\n            break\n    \n    print(\"\\n\" + \"=\"*70)\n    print(f\"Total entries: {entry_num}\")\n    \n    if found:\n        print(\"\\nFOUND ENTRIES for items 93-96:\")\n        for num, eid, hnd, desc in found:\n            print(f\"  Entry {num}: extra_id={eid} -&gt; handler=0x{hnd:05x} ({desc})\")\n    else:\n        print(\"\\nNo entries found pointing to item 93-96 grant code.\")\n",

}

Read raw data first to understand structure\n        raw = f.read(0x200)\n        \n        # Try 6-byte format first (most common)\n        entry_num = 0\n        found_any = False\n        for offset in range(0, min(len(raw), 0x180), 6):\n            entry_id, handler = struct.unpack_from('&lt;HI', raw, offset)\n            \n            if entry_id == 0xFFFF:\n                break\n            \n            if RANGE_START &lt;= handler &lt;= RANGE_END:\n                if not found_any:\n                    print(\"Found handlers in unanalyzed region:\")\n                    found_any = True\n                print(f\"  Entry {entry_num}: id=0x{entry_id:04x} ({entry_id}), handler=0x{handler:05x}\")\n            \n            entry_num += 1\n        \n        if not found_any:\n            # Also try 8-byte format (item table uses this)\n            entry_num = 0\n            for offset in range(0, min(len(raw), 0x200), 8):\n                item1, item2 = struct.unpack_from('&lt;HH', raw, offset)\n                handler = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', raw, offset + 4)[0]\n                \n                if item1 == 0xFFFF:\n                    break\n                \n                if RANGE_START &lt;= handler &lt;= RANGE_END:\n                    if not found_any:\n                        print(\"Found handlers (8-byte format):\")\n                        found_any = True\n                    print(f\"  Entry {entry_num}: item1={item1}, item2={item2}, handler=0x{handler:05x}\")\n                \n                entry_num += 1\n        \n        if not found_any:\n            print(\"  No handlers in unanalyzed region (0x1ec00-0x24157)\")\n",

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nSearch the room-specific script dispatch table at 0x47d24 for entries\npointing to item grant code.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\ndef data_to_file(addr):\n    return addr - 0x40000 + 0x43200\n\nTABLE_ADDR = 0x47d24\nRANGE_START = 0x1ec00\nRANGE_END = 0x24157\n\n# Target item grants\nTARGETS = {\n    0x21b58: \"Item 93 grant\",\n    0x21b6c: \"Item 94 grant\", \n    0x21b80: \"Item 95 grant (CD Player/Soundtrack)\",\n    0x21b94: \"Item 96 grant (Background Book)\",\n}\n\nwith open(\"files/JUEGO.EXE\", \"rb\") as f:\n    f.seek(data_to_file(TABLE_ADDR))\n    \n    print(f\"Room-Specific Script Dispatch Table at 0x{TABLE_ADDR:05x}\")\n    print(\"=\"*70)\n    print(\"Format: [extra_id:2, handler:4] - 6 bytes per entry\")\n    print(\"-\"*70)\n    \n    entry_num = 0\n    found = []\n    \n    while entry_num &lt; 200:  # Safety limit\n        data = f.read(6)\n        if len(data) &lt; 6:\n            break\n        \n        extra_id, handler = struct.unpack('&lt;HI', data)\n        \n        if extra_id == 0xFFFF:\n            print(f\"\\n[End of table at entry {entry_num}]\")\n            break\n        \n        marker = \"\"\n        if handler in TARGETS:\n            marker = f\" &lt;=== {TARGETS[handler]}\"\n            found.append((entry_num, extra_id, handler, TARGETS[handler]))\n        elif RANGE_START &lt;= handler &lt;= RANGE_END:\n            marker = \" (in unanalyzed region)\"\n        \n        # Print all entries or just interesting ones\n        if marker or extra_id in [93, 94, 95, 96, 0x5d, 0x5e, 0x5f, 0x60]:\n            print(f\"Entry {entry_num:3d}: extra_id=0x{extra_id:04x} ({extra_id:3d}), handler=0x{handler:05x}{marker}\")\n        \n        entry_num += 1\n    \n    print(f\"\\nTotal entries: {entry_num}\")\n    \n    if found:\n        print(\"\\n\" + \"=\"*70)\n        print(\"FOUND ENTRIES for items 93-96:\")\n        for num, eid, hnd, desc in found:\n            print(f\"  Entry {num}: extra_id=0x{eid:04x} ({eid}) -&gt; {desc}\")\n    else:\n        print(\"\\n\" + \"=\"*70)\n        print(\"No exact matches for item 93-96 grant code.\")\n        print(\"\\nListing ALL entries in unanalyzed region:\")\n        \n        f.seek(data_to_file(TABLE_ADDR))\n        entry_num = 0\n        while entry_num &lt; 200:\n            data = f.read(6)\n            if len(data) &lt; 6:\n                break\n            extra_id, handler = struct.unpack('&lt;HI', data)\n            if extra_id == 0xFFFF:\n                break\n            if RANGE_START &lt;= handler &lt;= RANGE_END:\n                print(f\"  Entry {entry_num}: extra_id=0x{extra_id:04x} ({extra_id}), handler=0x{handler:05x}\")\n            entry_num += 1\n",

  "pastTenseMessage": "Created [](file:///Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/find_jump_tables.py)",
  "isConfirmed": {
    "type": 1

  "content": "",
  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nScan the entire data section for ARRAYS of addresses that point\ninto the unanalyzed code region 0x1ec00-0x24157.\n\nThis will find jump tables / switch statement tables.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\ndef data_to_file(addr):\n    return addr - 0x40000 + 0x43200\n\n# Unanalyzed region\nRANGE_START = 0x1ec00\nRANGE_END = 0x24157\n\n# Scan data section from 0x40000 to 0x52000 (Ghidra addrs)\nDATA_START_GHIDRA = 0x40000\nDATA_END_GHIDRA = 0x52000\n\nwith open(\"files/JUEGO.EXE\", \"rb\") as f:\n    f.seek(data_to_file(DATA_START_GHIDRA))\n    data = f.read(DATA_END_GHIDRA - DATA_START_GHIDRA)\n\nprint(\"Scanning for jump tables pointing to unanalyzed region...\")\nprint(f\"Target region: 0x{RANGE_START:05x} - 0x{RANGE_END:05x}\")\nprint(\"=\"*70)\n\n# Look for consecutive 32-bit values that are valid code addresses in our range\nfound_tables = []\n\nfor i in range(0, len(data) - 16, 4):\n    # Read 4 consecutive dwords\n    vals = struct.unpack_from('&lt;IIII', data, i)\n    \n    # Check if at least 2 consecutive values point to our target range\n    in_range = sum(1 for v in vals if RANGE_START &lt;= v &lt;= RANGE_END)\n    \n    if in_range &gt;= 2:\n        ghidra_addr = DATA_START_GHIDRA + i\n        found_tables.append((ghidra_addr, vals))\n        \n        # Don't overlap with adjacent findings\n        i += 12\n\n# Print results\nif found_tables:\n    print(f\"\\nFound {len(found_tables)} potential jump tables:\\n\")\n    \n    for addr, vals in found_tables:\n        print(f\"Table at 0x{addr:05x}:\")\n        for j, v in enumerate(vals):\n            marker = \"\"\n            if RANGE_START &lt;= v &lt;= RANGE_END:\n                marker = \" &lt;-- in target range\"\n            print(f\"  [{j}] 0x{v:05x}{marker}\")\n        print()\nelse:\n    print(\"\\nNo jump tables found pointing to target region.\")\n    print(\"\\nThis suggests the code is reached via:\")\n    print(\"  1. Fall-through from previous code\")\n    print(\"  2. Computed jumps (JMP reg*4 + base)\")\n    print(\"  3. Single isolated CALLs\")\n\n# Also search for the specific target addresses\nprint(\"\\n\" + \"=\"*70)\nprint(\"Searching for exact references to item 95/96 grant addresses...\")\n\ntargets = [\n    (0x21b80, \"Item 95\"),\n    (0x21b94, \"Item 96\"),\n]\n\nfor target, desc in targets:\n    target_bytes = struct.pack('&lt;I', target)\n    pos = data.find(target_bytes)\n    if pos != -1:\n        ghidra_addr = DATA_START_GHIDRA + pos\n        print(f\"  Found reference to 0x{target:05x} ({desc}) at 0x{ghidra_addr:05x}\")\n    else:\n        print(f\"  No reference to 0x{target:05x} ({desc}) in data section\")\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nDisassemble the code immediately before 0x21b80 to understand\nhow execution reaches the item 95 grant code.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\ndef code_to_file(addr):\n    return addr - 0x10000 + 0x14200\n\n# Look at 0x21b70 - 0x21b80 (right before item 95)\nTARGET = 0x21b80\nBEFORE = 0x30  # Look 48 bytes before\n\nwith open(\"files/JUEGO.EXE\", \"rb\") as f:\n    f.seek(code_to_file(TARGET - BEFORE))\n    data = f.read(BEFORE + 0x20)\n\nprint(f\"Hex dump around item 95 grant (0x{TARGET:05x}):\")\nprint(\"=\"*70)\n\nfor i in range(0, len(data), 16):\n    addr = TARGET - BEFORE + i\n    line = data[i:i+16]\n    hexpart = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in line)\n    \n    marker = \"\"\n    if addr &lt;= TARGET &lt; addr + 16:\n        marker = \"  &lt;-- Item 95 here\"\n    \n    print(f\"0x{addr:05x}: {hexpart}{marker}\")\n\nprint(\"\\n\" + \"=\"*70)\nprint(\"Interpretation:\")\nprint()\n\n# Looking at the hex dump:\n# 0x21b6c: 68 04 00 00 00 e8 ac 86 00 00 = PUSH 4; CALL 0x2a218\n#          b8 5e 00 00 00                = MOV EAX, 94\n#          e9 e1 25 00 00                = JMP to process_inventory_action\n# 0x21b80: b8 5f 00 00 00                = MOV EAX, 95\n#          e9 cd 25 00 00                = JMP to process_inventory_action\n\n# The key is the PUSH 4; CALL pattern before each\n# This calls get_current_room_number with param 4\n# Then sets EAX to item ID and jumps to add item\n\n# What determines WHICH one is called? The entries before 0x21b58...\n# Let's look much further back\n\nprint(\"Looking further back for the dispatch logic...\")\nprint()\n\nLOOKBACK = 0x400  # Look 1KB back\n\nwith open(\"files/JUEGO.EXE\", \"rb\") as f:\n    f.seek(code_to_file(TARGET - LOOKBACK))\n    data = f.read(LOOKBACK)\n\n# Look for switch/dispatch patterns\n# Common patterns:\n# - JMP [EAX*4 + table]  = FF 24 85 XX XX XX XX\n# - JMP [reg*4 + reg] = FF 24 XX\n# - CMP + JE chains\n\n# Search for FF 24 (JMP indirect)\nfor i in range(len(data) - 6):\n    if data[i] == 0xFF and data[i+1] == 0x24:\n        addr = TARGET - LOOKBACK + i\n        modrm = data[i+2]\n        print(f\"  JMP indirect at 0x{addr:05x}: {data[i:i+7].hex()}\")\n\n# Search for switch jump patterns (JMP to computed address)\n# Often: MOVZX reg, byte; JMP [reg*4 + table]\n# Or: cmp reg, N; ja default; jmp [reg*4 + table]\n\nprint(\"\\nSearching for CMP + JA (switch bounds check)...\")\nfor i in range(len(data) - 6):\n    # CMP EAX, imm8 = 83 F8 XX\n    if data[i:i+2] == b'\\x83\\xf8' and i + 4 &lt; len(data):\n        if data[i+3] == 0x77:  # JA rel8\n            addr = TARGET - LOOKBACK + i\n            bound = data[i+2]\n            print(f\"  CMP EAX, {bound}; JA at 0x{addr:05x}\")\n",

}

{
  "invocationMessage": "Creating [](file:///Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/parse_item_grants.py)",
  "pastTenseMessage": "Created [](file:///Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/parse_item_grants.py)",
  "isConfirmed": {
    "type": 1
  },
  "content": "",
  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nParse the entire unanalyzed code region (0x1ec00-0x24157) to extract\nall the action entries and understand the dispatch mechanism.\n\nEach entry appears to have:\n- PUSH N; CALL get_current_room_number (some setup)  \n- MOV EAX, item_id\n- JMP process_inventory_action\n\nThe PUSH value before each might be the key to understanding what triggers each.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\ndef code_to_file(addr):\n    return addr - 0x10000 + 0x14200\n\n# Read the entire unanalyzed region\nSTART = 0x1ec00\nEND = 0x24157\n\nwith open(\"files/JUEGO.EXE\", \"rb\") as f:\n    f.seek(code_to_file(START))\n    data = f.read(END - START)\n\nprint(\"Parsing unanalyzed code region for item grant entries...\")\nprint(f\"Region: 0x{START:05x} - 0x{END:05x} ({len(data)} bytes)\")\nprint(\"=\"*70)\n\n# Look for the pattern: B8 XX XX XX XX E9 YY YY YY YY\n# (MOV EAX, imm32; JMP rel32)\n\nentries = []\npos = 0\nwhile pos &lt; len(data) - 10:\n    if data[pos] == 0xB8:  # MOV EAX, imm32\n        imm = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, pos + 1)[0]\n        \n        if data[pos + 5] == 0xE9:  # JMP rel32\n            rel = struct.unpack_from('&lt;i', data, pos + 6)[0]\n            addr = START + pos\n            jmp_target = addr + 10 + rel\n            \n            # Check if target is process_inventory_action\n            if jmp_target == 0x24157 or (jmp_target &gt; 0x24000 and jmp_target &lt; 0x25000):\n                # Look back for PUSH before CALL before MOV\n                # Pattern: 68 XX XX XX XX E8 YY YY YY YY B8 ZZ ZZ ZZ ZZ\n                if pos &gt;= 10 and data[pos-10] == 0x68 and data[pos-5] == 0xE8:\n                    push_val = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, pos - 9)[0]\n                    entries.append({\n                        'addr': addr,\n                        'item_id': imm,\n                        'jmp_target': jmp_target,\n                        'push_val': push_val\n                    })\n        \n    pos += 1\n\nprint(f\"\\nFound {len(entries)} item grant entries:\\n\")\n\n# Group by push value\nby_push = {}\nfor e in entries:\n    pv = e['push_val']\n    if pv not in by_push:\n        by_push[pv] = []\n    by_push[pv].append(e)\n\nfor push_val in sorted(by_push.keys()):\n    group = by_push[push_val]\n    print(f\"\\nPUSH {push_val} (0x{push_val:02x}) - {len(group)} entries:\")\n    for e in group:\n        marker = \"\"\n        if e['item_id'] == 95:\n            marker = \" &lt;== CD Player/Soundtrack\"\n        elif e['item_id'] == 96:\n            marker = \" &lt;== Background Book\"\n        print(f\"  0x{e['addr']:05x}: item {e['item_id']:3d} (0x{e['item_id']:02x}){marker}\")\n\nprint(\"\\n\" + \"=\"*70)\nprint(\"\\nThe PUSH value before CALL might indicate the action/room context.\")\nprint(\"PUSH 4 and PUSH 12 (0x0C) are common values seen.\")\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

CALL process_inventory_action\n        # Or: PUSH xxx; ...; CALL\n        \n        # Check for MOV EAX, imm32 at -5\n        if before[-5] == 0xB8:\n            item_id = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', before, len(before) - 4)[0]\n            print(f\"  -&gt; MOV EAX, {item_id} before CALL (item {item_id})\")\n        \n        print()\n\n# Also scan the region for ALL calls to process_inventory_action\nprint(\"=\"*70)\nprint(\"All calls to process_inventory_action (0x24157) in region:\")\nprint(\"-\"*70)\n\nSTART = 0x1ec00\nEND = 0x24157\n\nwith open(\"files/JUEGO.EXE\", \"rb\") as f:\n    f.seek(code_to_file(START))\n    data = f.read(END - START)\n\ncall_count = 0\nfor i in range(len(data) - 5):\n    if data[i] == 0xE8:  # CALL rel32\n        rel = struct.unpack_from('&lt;i', data, i + 1)[0]\n        target = START + i + 5 + rel\n        \n        if target == 0x24157:  # process_inventory_action\n            call_count += 1\n            addr = START + i\n            \n            # Check what's before\n            if i &gt;= 5 and data[i-5] == 0xB8:\n                item_id = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, i - 4)[0]\n                print(f\"  0x{addr:05x}: CALL process_inventory_action (item {item_id})\")\n            else:\n                print(f\"  0x{addr:05x}: CALL process_inventory_action\")\n\nprint(f\"\\nTotal calls: {call_count}\")\n",

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nRead the room-based dispatch table at 0x485bc used by main_game_loop.\nCheck if any entries point to the unanalyzed region.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\ndef data_to_file(addr):\n    return addr - 0x40000 + 0x43200\n\nTABLE_ADDR = 0x485bc\nRANGE_START = 0x1ec00\nRANGE_END = 0x24157\n\nwith open(\"files/JUEGO.EXE\", \"rb\") as f:\n    f.seek(data_to_file(TABLE_ADDR))\n    \n    print(f\"Main Game Loop Room Dispatch Table at 0x{TABLE_ADDR:05x}\")\n    print(\"=\"*70)\n    print(\"Format: [room_number:2, handler:4] - 6 bytes per entry\")\n    print(\"-\"*70)\n    \n    entry_num = 0\n    found = []\n    \n    while entry_num &lt; 100:\n        data = f.read(6)\n        if len(data) &lt; 6:\n            break\n        \n        room_num, handler = struct.unpack('&lt;HI', data)\n        \n        if room_num == 0xFFFF:\n            print(f\"\\n[End of table at entry {entry_num}]\")\n            break\n        \n        marker = \"\"\n        if RANGE_START &lt;= handler &lt;= RANGE_END:\n            marker = \" &lt;== IN UNANALYZED REGION\"\n            found.append((room_num, handler))\n        \n        print(f\"Entry {entry_num:2d}: room {room_num:2d} -&gt; handler 0x{handler:05x}{marker}\")\n        entry_num += 1\n    \n    print(f\"\\n{'='*70}\")\n    print(f\"Entries pointing to unanalyzed region: {len(found)}\")\n    \n    if found:\n        print(\"\\n MATCH FOUND!\")\n        for room, handler in found:\n            print(f\"  Room {room} -&gt; 0x{handler:05x}\")\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

  "textEditContent": "# Items 95 and 96 Investigation - Complete Analysis\n\n## Overview\n\nThis document analyzes inventory items 95 (CD Player/Soundtrack) and 96 (Background Book) in Alfred Pelrock, including how they are added to inventory and what happens when used on Alfred.\n\n## Item Descriptions\n\n| Item ID | Spanish Name | English Translation |\n|---------|--------------|---------------------|\n| 95 | Banda sonora de Alfred Pelrock | Soundtrack of Alfred Pelrock |\n| 96 | Un album con las pantallas de Alfred Pelrock | An album with the screens of Alfred Pelrock |\n\nThese are **bonus/extras** items that let players view the game's soundtrack and background art.\n\n## Item Combination Table Entry\n\nThe item combination table at &#96;0x48118&#96; contains self-use handlers for these items:\n\n| Entry | Item1 | Item2 | Handler | Purpose |\n|-------|-------|-------|---------|---------|\n| 43 | 95 | 95 | 0x146f4 | Use CD Player on Alfred |\n| 44 | 96 | 96 | 0x14ed7 | Use Background Book on Alfred |\n\n### Handler Analysis\n\n#### Handler 0x146f4 (Item 95 - CD Player)\n\n**Problem**: This address points INSIDE &#96;setup_action_menu_icons&#96; (0x14622-0x14750), not at a valid function entry point.\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nLocation: Inside setup_action_menu_icons\nBytes at 0x146f4: 05 83 e8 2c eb 1e\nInterpretation: ADD EAX, 0x2ce88305 (garbage)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThis is **broken/placeholder code** - the handler was never properly implemented.\n\n#### Handler 0x14ed7 (Item 96 - Background Book)\n\n**Problem**: This address points to the VERY END of &#96;init_memory_buffers&#96; (0x14bd0-0x14ee3).\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nLocation: End of init_memory_buffers\nBytes at 0x14ed7: 00 00 b0 01 5a 5b c3\nInterpretation: MOV AL, 1; POP EDX; POP EBX; RET\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThis handler simply **returns 1 (success)** without doing anything visible.\n\n## Item Grant Mechanism\n\n### Where Items Are Added to Inventory\n\nCode at &#96;0x21b80&#96; and &#96;0x21b94&#96; grants these items:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;asm\n; Item 95 grant at 0x21b80\n0x21b80: B8 5F 00 00 00    MOV EAX, 95\n0x21b85: E9 CD 25 00 00    JMP process_inventory_action (0x24157)\n\n; Item 96 grant at 0x21b94  \n0x21b94: B8 60 00 00 00    MOV EAX, 96\n0x21b99: E9 B9 25 00 00    JMP process_inventory_action (0x24157)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Unanalyzed Code Region\n\nThe item grant code is part of a large unanalyzed region:\n- **Address Range**: 0x1ec00 - 0x24157 (~22KB)\n- **Contains**: 34 direct calls + 8 jumps to &#96;process_inventory_action&#96;\n- **Pattern**: &#96;PUSH 4; CALL get_current_room_number; MOV EAX, item_id; JMP process_inventory_action&#96;\n\n### Items Granted in This Region\n\n| Address | Item ID | Item Name |\n|---------|---------|-----------|\n| 0x21b58 | 93 | Licor de arena (Sand liquor) |\n| 0x21b6c | 94 | Crema para el sol (Sunscreen) |\n| **0x21b80** | **95** | **Banda sonora (Soundtrack)** |\n| **0x21b94** | **96** | **Album de pantallas (Background Album)** |\n| 0x21dad | 102 | Naranjas de Nules |\n| 0x21e32 | 103 | Mogollón de naranjas |\n| 0x22185 | 105 | Folletos del SIDA |\n| 0x222f5 | 111 | Cinta del Rey Elvis |\n\n## Dispatch Mechanism (Unknown)\n\n**Problem**: No xrefs or jump tables reference the unanalyzed region.\n\nChecked tables:\n- F8 Action Dispatch Table (0x47e58) - No matches\n- Hotspot Action Table (0x47bf0) - No matches\n- Room-Specific Script Table (0x47d24) - No matches\n- Item Combination Table (0x48118) - No matches\n- Main Game Loop Table (0x485bc) - No matches\n\n**Hypothesis**: The code may be reached through:\n1. Fall-through from preceding code\n2. Computed jumps with base address not in data tables\n3. Legacy/dead code that was never properly integrated\n\n## F8 Action Codes\n\nThe F8 action table has entries for these item numbers:\n\n| F8 Action ID | Handler | Item Related |\n|--------------|---------|--------------|\n| 0x015F (351) | 0x1202f | Item 95 - inside &#96;init_sprite_scaling_tables&#96; |\n| 0x0160 (352) | 0x1151d | Item 96 - unanalyzed region |\n\nThese F8 handlers also point to invalid locations.\n\n## Conclusions\n\n### Why the CD Player \"Doesn't Work\"\n\nThe self-use handler at 0x146f4 points to invalid code inside another function. When the player uses the CD Player on Alfred:\n1. Game looks up handler in item combination table\n2. Calls address 0x146f4\n3. Executes garbage instructions from middle of &#96;setup_action_menu_icons&#96;\n4. Behavior is undefined/crashes\n\n### Why the Background Book \"Works\"\n\nThe self-use handler at 0x14ed7 is at the tail of &#96;init_memory_buffers&#96;:\n1. Game looks up handler in item combination table\n2. Calls address 0x14ed7\n3. Executes &#96;MOV AL, 1; POP; POP; RET&#96;\n4. Returns success without doing anything visible\n\nThe book might \"work\" because:\n- The actual book viewer code is called elsewhere (before the self-use handler)\n- Or the item triggers a different code path when first used\n\n### Recommendations for ScummVM Implementation\n\n1. **Item 95 (CD Player)**: Implement a proper soundtrack player\n2. **Item 96 (Background Book)**: Implement a background art gallery viewer\n3. **Grant Mechanism**: These items should be granted after game completion or through a specific puzzle/action\n4. **Self-Use Handlers**: Replace broken handlers with functional implementations\n\n## Technical Reference\n\n### Memory Addresses\n\n| Purpose | Ghidra Address | File Offset |\n|---------|----------------|-------------|\n| Item Combination Table | 0x48118 | 0x4B318 |\n| Item 95 Self-Use Handler | 0x146f4 | 0x188f4 |\n| Item 96 Self-Use Handler | 0x14ed7 | 0x190d7 |\n| Item 95 Grant Code | 0x21b80 | 0x25d80 |\n| Item 96 Grant Code | 0x21b94 | 0x25d94 |\n| process_inventory_action | 0x24157 | 0x28357 |\n\n### Offset Formulas\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nCode: file_offset = ghidra_addr - 0x10000 + 0x14200\nData: file_offset = ghidra_addr - 0x40000 + 0x43200\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n",

I've thoroughly investigated items 95 and 96. Here's the summary:

### Items 95 & 96 Details

| Item | Spanish Name | Description |
|------|--------------|-------------|
| 95 | Banda sonora de Alfred Pelrock | Game soundtrack viewer |
| 96 | Un album con las pantallas de Alfred Pelrock | Background art gallery |

### Key Findings

1. **Self-Use Handlers Are Broken**:
   - Item 95 handler (0x146f4) → Points INSIDE `setup_action_menu_icons` - **invalid code**
   - Item 96 handler (0x14ed7) → Points to END of `init_memory_buffers` - **just returns 1**

2. **Item Grant Code Exists** (at 0x21b80 and 0x21b94):
   - Both use: `MOV EAX, item_id; JMP process_inventory_action`
   - Located in a ~22KB unanalyzed code region (0x1ec00-0x24157)
   - **No dispatch tables reference this region** - the trigger mechanism is unknown

3. **Debug Access Works**:
   - Command line `o 95` adds item 95 to inventory
   - Command line `o 96` adds item 96 to inventory
   - This is why testing with `o 95 o 96` gives you both items

### Why CD Player "Doesn't Work"

When you use the CD Player on Alfred, the game calls handler 0x146f4 which points to garbage code inside another function. The behavior is undefined.

### Why Background Book "Works"

When you use the Background Book on Alfred, the handler at 0x14ed7 just executes `MOV AL, 1; RET` (return success). It doesn't crash, but it also doesn't DO anything. If the book shows something, that functionality must be elsewhere.

  "content": "",
  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nRe-read item combination table entries for items 95 and 96.\nTable at 0x48118, 8-byte entries: [item1:2, item2:2, handler:4]\nAlso search for CALL/JMP to 0x24700 (CD player function).\n\"\"\"\nimport struct\n\ndef data_to_file(addr):\n    return addr - 0x40000 + 0x43200\n\ndef code_to_file(addr):\n    return addr - 0x10000 + 0x14200\n\nTABLE_ADDR = 0x48118\nTABLE_FILE = data_to_file(TABLE_ADDR)\n\nwith open(\"files/JUEGO.EXE\", \"rb\") as f:\n    exe_data = f.read()\n\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\nprint(\"ITEM COMBINATION TABLE - ALL ENTRIES\")\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\n\nfor i in range(60):\n    offset = TABLE_FILE + i * 8\n    item1, item2, handler = struct.unpack_from('&lt;HHI', exe_data, offset)\n    if item1 == 0xFFFF:\n        print(f\"  Entry {i}: END (0xFFFF)\")\n        break\n    marker = \"\"\n    if item1 == 95 or item2 == 95:\n        marker = \" &lt;&lt;&lt;&lt; ITEM 95\"\n    if item1 == 96 or item2 == 96:\n        marker = \" &lt;&lt;&lt;&lt; ITEM 96\"\n    if item1 == item2:\n        marker += \" [SELF-USE]\"\n    print(f\"  Entry {i:2d}: item1={item1:3d} (0x{item1:04x}), item2={item2:3d} (0x{item2:04x}), handler=0x{handler:05x}{marker}\")\n\nprint()\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\nprint(\"SEARCH FOR CALL/JMP TO 0x24700 (CD Player Function)\")\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\n\n# In x86-32, CALL rel32 = E8 xx xx xx xx\n# JMP rel32 = E9 xx xx xx xx\n# Target = instruction_addr + 5 + displacement\ntarget_code = 0x24700\n\n# Search code section (0x14200 to ~0x3E200 in file)\ncode_start_file = 0x14200\ncode_end_file = 0x43200  # end of code section\n\nfor opcode, name in [(0xe8, \"CALL\"), (0xe9, \"JMP\")]:\n    print(f\"\\n  {name} instructions targeting 0x{target_code:05x}:\")\n    found = 0\n    for pos in range(code_start_file, code_end_file - 5):\n        if exe_data[pos] == opcode:\n            disp = struct.unpack_from('&lt;i', exe_data, pos + 1)[0]\n            ghidra_pos = pos - 0x14200 + 0x10000\n            call_target = ghidra_pos + 5 + disp\n            if call_target == target_code:\n                found += 1\n                print(f\"    At file 0x{pos:05x} (Ghidra 0x{ghidra_pos:05x}): {name} 0x{target_code:05x}\")\n    if found == 0:\n        print(f\"    None found\")\n\nprint()\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\nprint(\"SEARCH FOR CALL/JMP TO 0x24700 region (0x24600-0x24800)\")\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\n\n# Broader search - maybe the entry point is slightly different\nfor opcode, name in [(0xe8, \"CALL\"), (0xe9, \"JMP\")]:\n    print(f\"\\n  {name} targets in range 0x24600-0x24800:\")\n    found = 0\n    for pos in range(code_start_file, code_end_file - 5):\n        if exe_data[pos] == opcode:\n            disp = struct.unpack_from('&lt;i', exe_data, pos + 1)[0]\n            ghidra_pos = pos - 0x14200 + 0x10000\n            call_target = ghidra_pos + 5 + disp\n            if 0x24600 &lt;= call_target &lt;= 0x24800:\n                found += 1\n                print(f\"    At file 0x{pos:05x} (Ghidra 0x{ghidra_pos:05x}): {name} 0x{call_target:05x}\")\n    if found == 0:\n        print(f\"    None found\")\n\nprint()\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\nprint(\"SEARCH FOR CALL/JMP TO item 95/96 handlers (0x146f0-0x14f00)\")\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\n\n# Specifically looking for calls TO 0x146f4 and 0x14ed7\nfor target_addr in [0x146f4, 0x14ed7]:\n    for opcode, name in [(0xe8, \"CALL\"), (0xe9, \"JMP\")]:\n        found = 0\n        for pos in range(code_start_file, code_end_file - 5):\n            if exe_data[pos] == opcode:\n                disp = struct.unpack_from('&lt;i', exe_data, pos + 1)[0]\n                ghidra_pos = pos - 0x14200 + 0x10000\n                call_target = ghidra_pos + 5 + disp\n                if call_target == target_addr:\n                    found += 1\n                    print(f\"    {name} to 0x{target_addr:05x} from Ghidra 0x{ghidra_pos:05x}\")\n        if found == 0:\n            print(f\"    No {name} to 0x{target_addr:05x}\")\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nRead raw bytes of item combination table entries 40-46 to verify handler addresses.\nThen decode instructions starting at the handler address 0x146f4 for item 95.\n\"\"\"\nimport struct\n\ndef data_to_file(addr):\n    return addr - 0x40000 + 0x43200\n\ndef code_to_file(addr):\n    return addr - 0x10000 + 0x14200\n\nTABLE_ADDR = 0x48118\n\nwith open(\"files/JUEGO.EXE\", \"rb\") as f:\n    exe_data = f.read()\n\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\nprint(\"RAW BYTES OF TABLE ENTRIES 40-46\")\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\n\nfor i in range(40, 47):\n    entry_addr = TABLE_ADDR + i * 8\n    file_off = data_to_file(entry_addr)\n    raw = exe_data[file_off:file_off + 8]\n    item1, item2, handler = struct.unpack_from('&lt;HHI', raw, 0)\n    print(f\"  Entry {i}: Ghidra 0x{entry_addr:05x}, raw={raw.hex()}\")\n    print(f\"    item1={item1} (0x{item1:04x}), item2={item2} (0x{item2:04x}), handler=0x{handler:05x}\")\n\nprint()\nprint(\"=\" * 70) \nprint(\"CHECKING: Is handler 0x146f4 the address, or do I need to check dispatch?\")\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\n\n# Let's re-read the dispatch mechanism decompilation\n# The decompiled code says:\n# (*(code *)(&amp;PTR_LAB_0004811c)[(extraout_EDX &amp; 0xff) * 2])();\n# PTR_LAB_0004811c is at table + 4. Index = entry * 2.\n# code* = 4 bytes. So offset from 0x4811c = entry * 2 * 4 = entry * 8\n# Handler addr at 0x4811c + 43 * 8 = 0x4811c + 0x158 = 0x48274\n\nprint(f\"  Handler for entry 43 at data addr: 0x{0x4811c + 43*8:05x}\")\nfile_off = data_to_file(0x4811c + 43 * 8)\nraw_handler = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', exe_data, file_off)[0]\nprint(f\"  Handler value: 0x{raw_handler:05x}\")\n\n# Also check: maybe the dispatch uses a DIFFERENT offset\nprint(f\"\\n  Handler for entry 44 at data addr: 0x{0x4811c + 44*8:05x}\")\nfile_off2 = data_to_file(0x4811c + 44 * 8)\nraw_handler2 = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', exe_data, file_off2)[0]\nprint(f\"  Handler value: 0x{raw_handler2:05x}\")\n\nprint()\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\nprint(\"DISASSEMBLY AROUND 0x146f0-0x14760 (raw bytes)\")\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\n\n# Read from Ghidra listing - the instructions around 0x146f4\n# From the Ghidra disassembly, we know:\n# 000146f0: CMP EAX,0x39    = 83 f8 39 (3 bytes)\n# 000146f3: JL 0x000146fa   = 7c 05 (2 bytes)\n# 000146f5: SUB EAX,0x2c    = 83 e8 2c (3 bytes)\n# 000146f8: JMP 0x00014718  = eb 1e (2 bytes)\n\n# So handler 0x146f4 starts at byte 2 of \"JL 0x146fa\" (7c 05)\n# Byte at 0x146f4 = 0x05\n\n# But WAIT - maybe Ghidra's disassembly is wrong? \n# Let's check if the address really IS 0x146f4 or slightly different\n\n# Re-read entry 43 very carefully\nentry_43_file = data_to_file(0x48118 + 43 * 8)\nraw_entry = exe_data[entry_43_file:entry_43_file + 8]\nprint(f\"  Entry 43 raw bytes: {raw_entry.hex()}\")\nprint(f\"  Byte 0-1 (item1): {struct.unpack_from('&lt;H', raw_entry, 0)[0]}\")\nprint(f\"  Byte 2-3 (item2): {struct.unpack_from('&lt;H', raw_entry, 2)[0]}\")\nprint(f\"  Byte 4-7 (handler): 0x{struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', raw_entry, 4)[0]:05x}\")\n\nprint()\n# Now let me check the FIRST loop in execute_complex_item_script_table\n# It checks item1 == item2 AND item1 == current_item AND current_hotspot_extra_id == 0\n# This is the \"self-use on alfred\" path. When it matches, it calls handler.\n\n# The question is: does the handler at 0x146f4 work despite being mid-instruction?\n# Let me verify by looking at what 0x146f4 actually executes\n\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\nprint(\"ACTUAL DECODE FROM 0x146f4 (overlapping code)\")\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\n\nstart = code_to_file(0x146f4)\nblock = exe_data[start:start + 120]\nprint(\"  Raw bytes from 0x146f4:\")\nfor i in range(0, len(block), 16):\n    addr = 0x146f4 + i\n    hexbytes = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in block[i:i+16])\n    print(f\"    0x{addr:05x}: {hexbytes}\")\n\nprint()\nprint(\"  Manual x86 decode from 0x146f4:\")\n# 05 83 e8 2c eb = ADD EAX, 0xEB2CE883 - GARBAGE\n# Unless... this is 16-bit mode?? No, this is 32-bit protected mode.\n\n# Actually wait - let me check: maybe the function_entry_index calculation\n# is off by one and the actual handler is at 0x146f5 instead\n# 0x146f5: 83 e8 2c = SUB EAX, 0x2c → That makes sense for item_id adjustment!\n\nalt_handler = 0x146f5\nfile_off_alt = code_to_file(alt_handler)\nprint(f\"\\n  What if handler is actually 0x{alt_handler:05x}?\")\nprint(f\"    0x146f5: 83 e8 2c = SUB EAX, 0x2C (subtract 44)\")\nprint(f\"    0x146f8: eb 1e    = JMP +0x1e → 0x14718\")\nprint(f\"  That's the same as what Ghidra shows in setup_action_menu_icons!\")\nprint(f\"  So maybe the table contains 0x146f5, not 0x146f4?\")\n\nprint()\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\nprint(\"LET ME CHECK: Adjacent entries for off-by-one\")\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\n\n# What if the table format is [item1:2, item2:1, handler:4, padding:1]?\n# Or [item1:2, item2:2, handler:4] but handler is at offset 5 not 4?\n# Let me try different interpretations\n\nfor off in [3, 4, 5]:\n    entry_43_file = data_to_file(0x48118 + 43 * 8)\n    handler = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', exe_data, entry_43_file + off)[0]\n    print(f\"  Handler at byte offset {off}: 0x{handler:05x}\")\n\n# Also check if maybe the item2 field is 1 byte\nentry_43_file = data_to_file(0x48118 + 43 * 8)\nraw = exe_data[entry_43_file:entry_43_file + 8]\n# Alternative: [item1:2, item2:1, handler:4]  \nalt_item2 = raw[2]\nalt_handler_alt = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', raw, 3)[0]\nprint(f\"\\n  Alternative: [item1:2, item2_byte:{alt_item2}, handler:0x{alt_handler_alt:05x}]\")\n\n# Also check entry 42 (item 109 self-use) \nprint()\nentry_42_file = data_to_file(0x48118 + 42 * 8)\nraw42 = exe_data[entry_42_file:entry_42_file + 8]\nitem1_42, item2_42, handler_42 = struct.unpack_from('&lt;HHI', raw42, 0)\nprint(f\"  Entry 42: item1={item1_42}, item2={item2_42}, handler=0x{handler_42:05x}\")\nprint(f\"    Is 0x{handler_42:05x} on instruction boundary?\")\n# 0x146ba - let me check the disassembly\n# From setup_action_menu_icons listing:\n# 000146b7: XOR EAX,EAX       (31 c0)\n# 000146b9: MOV AX,SI          (66 89 f0) → wait, 66 is operand size prefix, then 89 f0? No...\n# MOV AX,SI = 66 8B C6? Or... let me check.\n# Actually: MOV AX, SI can be encoded as 66 89 F0 (MOV r/m16, r16 with operand override)\n# So 0x146b9 = 66 89 f0 (3 bytes), next at 0x146bc\n# 0x146ba would be in the middle of MOV AX,SI instruction!\n# Same pattern!\n\nprint(f\"  At 0x146b9: 66 89 f0 = MOV AX, SI\")\nprint(f\"  Handler 0x146ba is byte 2 of this instruction\")\nprint(f\"  Byte at 0x146ba = 0x{exe_data[code_to_file(0x146ba)]:02x}\")\n",

{
  "invocationMessage": "Creating [](file:///Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/check_all_handlers.py)",
  "pastTenseMessage": "Created [](file:///Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/check_all_handlers.py)",
  "isConfirmed": {
    "type": 1
  },
  "content": "",
  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nCheck the first bytes at ALL self-use handler addresses to see if they make\nsense as x86 instruction starts. This will help determine if the table\nformat is correct or has an off-by-one.\n\"\"\"\nimport struct\n\ndef code_to_file(addr):\n    return addr - 0x10000 + 0x14200\n\nwith open(\"files/JUEGO.EXE\", \"rb\") as f:\n    exe_data = f.read()\n\n# Self-use handlers from the table\nself_use_entries = [\n    (8, 9, 0x12e3d),\n    (11, 63, 0x12ff7),\n    (15, 0, 0x12f07),\n    (16, 24, 0x12f22),\n    (17, 34, 0x12f7b),\n    (18, 59, 0x12f96),\n    (19, 17, 0x12fd5),\n    (20, 64, 0x13088),\n    (23, 88, 0x13310),\n    (24, 87, 0x1387e),\n    (32, 97, 0x13f03),\n    (35, 98, 0x141e8),\n    (38, 84, 0x1448a),\n    (40, 101, 0x1462b),\n    (41, 108, 0x1464e),\n    (42, 109, 0x146ba),\n    (43, 95, 0x146f4),\n    (44, 96, 0x14ed7),\n    (45, 11, 0x15471),\n]\n\n# Common x86 instruction start bytes\nPUSH_BYTES = set(range(0x50, 0x58))  # PUSH reg\nVALID_STARTS = {\n    0x52: \"PUSH EDX\",\n    0x53: \"PUSH EBX\",\n    0x55: \"PUSH EBP\",\n    0x56: \"PUSH ESI\",\n    0x57: \"PUSH EDI\",\n    0x68: \"PUSH imm32\",\n    0x6a: \"PUSH imm8\",\n    0x31: \"XOR r32, r32\",\n    0x33: \"XOR r32, r32\",\n    0xb8: \"MOV EAX, imm32\",\n    0xb9: \"MOV ECX, imm32\",\n    0xba: \"MOV EDX, imm32\",\n    0xbb: \"MOV EBX, imm32\",\n    0x83: \"SUB/CMP/ADD r32, imm8\",\n    0x89: \"MOV r/m32, r32\",\n    0x8b: \"MOV r32, r/m32\",\n    0xa1: \"MOV EAX, [mem]\",\n    0xa3: \"MOV [mem], EAX\",\n    0xc3: \"RET\",\n    0xc7: \"MOV r/m32, imm32\",\n    0xe8: \"CALL rel32\",\n    0xe9: \"JMP rel32\",\n    0x0f: \"two-byte opcode (MOVZX, MOVSX, etc)\",\n    0x30: \"XOR r8, r8\",\n    0x66: \"operand size prefix\",\n    0x80: \"ADD/SUB/CMP r/m8, imm8\",\n}\n\nprint(\"=\" * 80)\nprint(\"FIRST BYTES OF ALL SELF-USE HANDLERS\")\nprint(\"=\" * 80)\nprint(f\"{'Entry':&gt;5} {'Item':&gt;4} {'Handler':&gt;10}  First 8 bytes          Valid start?\")\nprint(\"-\" * 80)\n\nfor entry_idx, item_id, handler_addr in self_use_entries:\n    file_off = code_to_file(handler_addr)\n    first_bytes = exe_data[file_off:file_off + 8]\n    hexstr = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in first_bytes)\n    \n    first_byte = first_bytes[0]\n    if first_byte in VALID_STARTS:\n        valid = f\"YES ({VALID_STARTS[first_byte]})\"\n    elif first_byte in PUSH_BYTES:\n        valid = f\"YES (PUSH reg)\"\n    elif first_byte == 0x05:\n        valid = \"SUSPICIOUS (ADD EAX, imm32)\"\n    else:\n        valid = f\"UNKNOWN (0x{first_byte:02x})\"\n    \n    marker = \"\"\n    if handler_addr in (0x146f4, 0x14ed7):\n        marker = \" &lt;&lt;\"\n    \n    print(f\"  {entry_idx:3d}  {item_id:3d}  0x{handler_addr:05x}  {hexstr}  {valid}{marker}\")\n\nprint()\nprint(\"=\" * 80)\nprint(\"WHAT'S AT 0x146f4 - 1 (i.e., 0x146f3)?\")\nprint(\"=\" * 80)\n# Check if maybe the handler   "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nDecode the F8 handlers for room 22 actions 349-351 at their real addresses \n(+0x10000 fixup applied). These are the handlers that give the CD to the player.\n\"\"\"\nimport struct\n\ndef code_to_file(addr):\n    return addr - 0x10000 + 0x14200\n\nwith open(\"files/JUEGO.EXE\", \"rb\") as f:\n    exe_data = f.read()\n\n# Real addresses after fixup\nhandlers = [\n    (349, 0x21fc8, \"action_349_disable_conv_root\"),\n    (350, 0x21ffb, \"action_350_unknown\"),\n    (351, 0x2202f, \"action_351_trigger_conversation\"),\n]\n\nfor action_id, real_addr, desc in handlers:\n    print(f\"{'='*70}\")\n    print(f\"F8 ACTION {action_id} HANDLER at 0x{real_addr:05x} ({desc})\")\n    print(f\"{'='*70}\")\n    \n    file_off = code_to_file(real_addr)\n    block = exe_data[file_off:file_off + 128]\n    \n    # Hex dump\n    for i in range(0, 128, 16):\n        addr = real_addr + i\n        hexbytes = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in block[i:i+16])\n        print(f\"  0x{addr:05x}: {hexbytes}\")\n    \n    # Trace CALL/JMP targets\n    print(f\"\\n  CALL/JMP targets:\")\n    for i in range(min(len(block) - 5, 200)):\n        b = block[i]\n        addr_cur = real_addr + i\n        if b == 0xe8:  # CALL rel32\n            disp = struct.unpack_from('&lt;i', block, i + 1)[0]\n            target = addr_cur + 5 + disp\n            print(f\"    0x{addr_cur:05x}: CALL 0x{target:05x}\")\n        elif b == 0xe9:  # JMP rel32\n            disp = struct.unpack_from('&lt;i', block, i + 1)[0]\n            target = addr_cur + 5 + disp\n            print(f\"    0x{addr_cur:05x}: JMP  0x{target:05x}\")\n    print()\n\n# Also check: where does item 95 get added to inventory?\n# The grant code at 0x21b80 (found earlier): MOV EAX, 95; JMP process_inventory_action\n# With fixup: the real address would be 0x21b80 + 0x10000 = 0x31b80??? \n# Wait, no - 0x21b80 was found by searching WITHIN the code section, not from a table.\n# The bytes at 0x21b80 are at file offset 0x21b80 - 0x10000 + 0x14200 = 0x25d80.\n# Let me verify.\n\nprint(f\"{'='*70}\")\nprint(\"ITEM 95 GRANT CODE AT 0x21b80\")\nprint(f\"{'='*70}\")\n\naddr = 0x21b80\nfile_off = code_to_file(addr)\nblock = exe_data[file_off:file_off + 32]\nhexstr = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in block)\nprint(f\"  0x{addr:05x}: {hexstr}\")\n\n# This should be: b8 5f000000 e9 xxxx = MOV EAX, 95; JMP process_inventory_action\n# process_inventory_action is at 0x24157 (or does IT also need fixup?)\n# Wait - 0x24157 was a Ghidra address. If it's in the analyzed region, it should be correct.\n# But the JMP displacement is computed from the raw bytes...\n\n# Let me decode:\nif block[0] == 0xb8:\n    imm = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', block, 1)[0]\n    print(f\"  MOV EAX, {imm} (item ID)\")\n    if block[5] == 0xe9:\n        disp = struct.unpack_from('&lt;i', block, 6)[0]\n        target = addr + 10 + disp\n        print(f\"  JMP 0x{target:05x} (process_inventory_action?)\")\n\nprint()\nprint(f\"{'='*70}\")\nprint(\"ITEM 96 GRANT CODE AT 0x21b94\")\nprint(f\"{'='*70}\")\n\naddr = 0x21b94\nfile_off = code_to_file(addr)\nblock = exe_data[file_off:file_off + 32]\nhexstr = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in block)\nprint(f\"  0x{addr:05x}: {hexstr}\")\n\nif block[0] == 0xb8:\n    imm = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', block, 1)[0]\n    print(f\"  MOV EAX, {imm} (item ID)\")\n    if block[5] == 0xe9:\n        disp = struct.unpack_from('&lt;i', block, 6)[0]\n        target = addr + 10 + disp\n        print(f\"  JMP 0x{target:05x} (process_inventory_action?)\")\n\n# Now check what calls 0x21b80 - trace who references this address\nprint()\nprint(f\"{'='*70}\")\nprint(\"SEARCHING FOR CALL/JMP TO 0x21b80 and 0x21b94\")\nprint(f\"{'='*70}\")\n\ncode_start = 0x14200\ncode_end = 0x43200\n\nfor target_addr in [0x21b80, 0x21b94]:\n    for opcode_byte, name in [(0xe8, \"CALL\"), (0xe9, \"JMP\")]:\n        for pos in range(code_start, code_end - 5):\n            if exe_data[pos] == opcode_byte:\n                disp = struct.unpack_from('&lt;i', exe_data, pos + 1)[0]\n                ghidra_pos = pos - 0x14200 + 0x10000\n                call_target = ghidra_pos + 5 + disp\n                if call_target == target_addr:\n                    print(f\"  {name} to 0x{target_addr:05x} from 0x{ghidra_pos:05x}\")\n",

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nFind ALL item grants through both direct (JMP process_inventory_action)\nand indirect (JMP shared_stub that calls process_inventory_action) paths.\nAlso check what's at the other shared targets (0x21e61, 0x222e3).\n\"\"\"\nimport struct\n\ndef code_to_file(addr):\n    return addr - 0x10000 + 0x14200\n\nFIXUP = 0x10000\nPROC_INV = 0x24157\n\nwith open(\"files/JUEGO.EXE\", \"rb\") as f:\n    exe_data = f.read()\n\n# First, find ALL shared stubs that start with CALL process_inventory_action  \n# (i.e., all addresses where we see E8 xx xx xx xx that targets 0x24157)\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\nprint(\"ALL locations that CALL process_inventory_action\")\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\n\ncode_start = 0x14200\ncode_end = 0x43200\n\ncall_sites = []\nfor pos in range(code_start, code_end - 5):\n    if exe_data[pos] == 0xe8:\n        disp = struct.unpack_from('&lt;i', exe_data, pos + 1)[0]\n        ghidra = pos - 0x14200 + 0x10000\n        target = ghidra + 5 + disp\n        if target == PROC_INV:\n            call_sites.append(ghidra)\n\nprint(f\"  Found {len(call_sites)} CALL sites to process_inventory_action (0x24157)\")\nfor addr in call_sites[:30]:\n    print(f\"    0x{addr:05x}\")\nif len(call_sites) &gt; 30:\n    print(f\"    ... and {len(call_sites)-30} more\")\n\n# Check what's at the shared JMP targets from room 22 handlers\nprint()\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\nprint(\"SHARED JMP TARGETS from room 22 handlers\")\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\n\nshared_targets = [0x217a9, 0x21e61, 0x222e3, 0x21ac1, 0x21b1a]\nfor addr in shared_targets:\n    file_off = code_to_file(addr)\n    block = exe_data[file_off:file_off + 40]\n    hexstr = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in block[:20])\n    print(f\"  0x{addr:05x}: {hexstr}\")\n    # Check if first instruction is CALL process_inventory_action\n    if block[0] == 0xe8:\n        disp = struct.unpack_from('&lt;i', block, 1)[0]\n        target = addr + 5 + disp\n        print(f\"    → CALL 0x{target:05x} {'(process_inventory_action!)' if target == PROC_INV else ''}\")\n\n# Now, re-analyze room 22 F8 handlers looking for MOV EAX, &lt;item&gt; before ANY JMP  \n# that leads to process_inventory_action (both direct and through shared stubs)\nprint()\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\nprint(\"ROOM 22 FULL HANDLER ANALYSIS - ALL MOV EAX + JMP patterns\")\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\n\n# Read F8 table\nf8_file = 0x47e58 - 0x40000 + 0x43200\nentries = []\npos = f8_file\nwhile True:\n    action_id, handler_raw = struct.unpack_from('&lt;HI', exe_data, pos)\n    if action_id == 0xFFFF:\n        break\n    entries.append((action_id, handler_raw + FIXUP))\n    pos += 6\n\n# For each handler, scan ALL bytes (up to 500) for MOV EAX patterns followed by JMP\nfor action_id, real_handler in entries:\n    if not (330 &lt;= action_id &lt;= 360):\n        continue\n    \n    file_off = code_to_file(real_handler)\n    # Read more bytes this time\n    block = exe_data[file_off:file_off + 500]\n    \n    grants = []\n    \n    # Find RET instruction to know function end\n    func_end = len(block)\n    for i in range(len(block)):\n        if block[i] == 0xc3:  # RET\n            func_end = i + 1\n            break\n    \n    # Find ALL MOV EAX, imm32 (B8 xx xx xx xx)\n    mov_eax_positions = []\n    for i in range(min(func_end, len(block) - 5)):\n        if block[i] == 0xb8:\n            val = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', block, i + 1)[0]\n            if val &lt; 200:\n                mov_eax_positions.append((i, val))\n    \n    # Find ALL JMP rel32 (E9 xx xx xx xx)\n    jmp_positions = []\n    for i in range(min(func_end, len(block) - 5)):\n        if block[i] == 0xe9:\n            disp = struct.unpack_from('&lt;i', block, i + 1)[0]\n            target = real_handler + i + 5 + disp\n            jmp_positions.append((i, target))\n    \n    if mov_eax_positions or jmp_positions:\n        print(f\"\\n  Action {action_id} (0x{real_handler:05x}), func_end=+{func_end}:\")\n        for off, val in mov_eax_positions:\n            print(f\"    +{off:3d}: MOV EAX, {val}\")\n        for off, target in jmp_positions:\n            is_proc = \" → process_inventory_action\" if target == PROC_INV else \"\"\n            is_shared = \" → shared_stub (calls proc_inv)\" if target == 0x217a9 else \"\"\n            print(f\"    +{off:3d}: JMP 0x{target:05x}{is_proc}{is_shared}\")\n\n# Also: look for MOV EAX, 95 (0x5F) with ANY encoding in a wider search\nprint()\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\nprint(\"SEARCH: Any way EAX could become 95 in code section\")\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\n\n# MOV EAX, 95 — B8 5F 00 00 00\n# MOV AL, 95 — B0 5F\n# XOR EAX, EAX (31 C0) then MOV AL, 95 (B0 5F)\n# PUSH 95;   "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\n1. Check room 22 hotspot data for any hotspot with extra_id = 95 or 96\n2. Read the action dispatch table at 0x47d24 (the REAL table base)\n3. Compare with previously known F8 table at 0x47e58\n\"\"\"\nimport struct\n\ndef code_to_file(addr):\n    return addr - 0x10000 + 0x14200\n\ndef data_to_file(addr):\n    return addr - 0x40000 + 0x43200\n\nwith open(\"files/JUEGO.EXE\", \"rb\") as f:\n    exe = f.read()\n\nwith open(\"files/ALFRED.1\", \"rb\") as f:\n    alfred1 = f.read()\n\n# ==== ROOM 22 HOTSPOTS ====\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\nprint(\"ROOM 22 HOTSPOT DATA\")\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\n\n# Room directory: 56 rooms x 13 pairs (offset+size) = room 22 starts at 22 * 26 * 4\n# Each room has 13 data pairs, pair 10 = hotspots/walkboxes/exits\nroom_idx = 22  # 0-indexed room 22\nroom_dir_offset = room_idx * 13 * 2 * 4  # 13 pairs, each pair is 8 bytes (offset + size)\n\n# Read pair 10 (hotspots/walkboxes/exits)\npair10_off = room_dir_offset + 10 * 8\ndata_offset = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', alfred1, pair10_off)[0]\ndata_size = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', alfred1, pair10_off + 4)[0]\n\nprint(f\"Room 22 pair 10: offset=0x{data_offset:x}, size=0x{data_size:x}\")\n\nroom_data = alfred1[data_offset:data_offset + data_size]\n\n# Hotspots: count at +0x47A, data at +0x47C, 9 bytes each\nif len(room_data) &gt; 0x47C:\n    hotspot_count = room_data[0x47A]\n    print(f\"Hotspot count: {hotspot_count}\")\n    \n    for i in range(hotspot_count):\n        offset = 0x47C + i * 9\n        hs_data = room_data[offset:offset + 9]\n        if len(hs_data) &lt; 9:\n            break\n        # Hotspot format: x1, y1, x2, y2 (2 bytes each), extra_id (1 byte) - or similar\n        # Actually let me just dump raw bytes and the extra_id\n        hs_hex = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in hs_data)\n        # Try different interpretations\n        vals_u8 = list(hs_data)\n        vals_u16 = struct.unpack_from('&lt;HHHH', hs_data, 0) if len(hs_data) &gt;= 8 else ()\n        \n        print(f\"  Hotspot {i}: raw={hs_hex}\")\n        if len(hs_data) &gt;= 9:\n            # Common format: x1(2), y1(2), x2(2), y2(2), action_id(1)\n            x1, y1, x2, y2 = struct.unpack_from('&lt;HHHH', hs_data, 0)\n            action_byte = hs_data[8]\n            print(f\"    Interpretation A (4xU16 + U8): ({x1},{y1})-({x2},{y2}) action={action_byte}\")\n            \n            # Or: x1(1), y1(1), x2(1), y2(1), ... action_id(2)\n            action_u16 = struct.unpack_from('&lt;H', hs_data, 7)[0]\n            print(f\"    Interpretation B (last 2 bytes U16): action_u16={action_u16}\")\nelse:\n    print(\"Room data too small for hotspot offset\")\n\n# Also check the extra_id field - it's stored in game memory at 0x51760\n# Let's find how hotspot clicks set current_hotspot_extra_id\nprint()\n\n# ==== WIDER HOTSPOT DATA ====\n# The hotspot structure in this game may be different. Let me check the doc.\n# From copilot-instructions: Hotspot: 9 bytes each at room_data+0x47C, count at +0x47A\n# Let me also check what looks like an action ID\n\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\nprint(\"ROOM 22 HOTSPOT SCAN: looking for byte value 95 (0x5F) or 96 (0x60)\")\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\n\nfor i in range(hotspot_count):\n    offset = 0x47C + i * 9\n    hs = room_data[offset:offset + 9]\n    for j, b in enumerate(hs):\n        if b == 95 or b == 96:\n            hs_hex = ' '.join(f'{bb:02x}' for bb in hs)\n            print(f\"  Hotspot {i}, byte {j} = {b}: {hs_hex}\")\n\n# Check 16-bit values too\nfor i in range(hotspot_count):\n    offset = 0x47C + i * 9\n    hs = room_data[offset:offset + 9]\n    for j in range(len(hs) - 1):\n        val16 = struct.unpack_from('&lt;H', hs, j)[0]\n        if val16 == 95 or val16 == 96:\n            hs_hex = ' '.join(f'{bb:02x}' for bb in hs)\n            print(f\"  Hotspot {i}, offset {j} = U16:{val16}: {hs_hex}\")\n\n# ==== ACTION DISPATCH TABLE ====\nprint()\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\nprint(\"ACTION DISPATCH TABLE at 0x47d24 (vs F8 table at 0x47e58)\")  \nprint(\"=\" * 70)\n\n# Read from 0x47d24\ntable_file = data_to_file(0x47d24)\npos = table_file\nall_entries = []\nwhile True:\n    action_id, handler_raw = struct.unpack_from('&lt;HI', exe, pos)\n    if action_id == 0xFFFF:\n        ghidra = 0x47d24 + (pos - table_file)\n        print(f\"  End marker at 0x{ghidra:05x} (offset +{pos - table_file})\")\n        break\n    all_entries.append((action_id, handler_raw, pos - table_file))\n    pos += 6\n\nprint(f\"  Total entries: {len(all_entries)}\")\nprint(f\"  First entry: action={all_entries[0][0]}, handler=0x{all_entries[0][1]:05x}\")\nprint(f\"  Last entry:  action={all_entries[-1][0]}, handler=0x{all_entries[-1][1]:05x}\")\n\n# Check if any entry has action_id between 90-100\nprint()\nprint(\"Entries with action_id 90-100:\")\nfor action_id, handler_raw, off in all_entries:\n    if 90 &lt;= action_id &lt;= 100:\n        print(f\"  action={action_id}, handler=0x{handler_raw:05x} (+0x10000 = 0x{handler_raw + 0x10000:05x}), table_off=+{off}\")\n\n# Check where the previously-known F8 table starts within this table\nprint()\nprint(\"Entries with action_id 330-351 (room 22 range):\")\nfor action_id, handler_raw, off in all_entries:\n    if 330 &lt;= action_id &lt;= 351:\n        ghidra_table = 0x47d24 + off\n        print(f\"  action={action_id} at 0x{ghidra_table:05x}, handler=0x{handler_raw + 0x10000:05x}\")\n        \n# Also show the first 10 entries\nprint()\nprint(\"First 10 entries:\")\nfor i, (action_id, handler_raw, off) in enumerate(all_entries[:10]):\n    print(f\"  [{i}] action={action_id}, handler=0x{handler_raw:05x} (+fixup = 0x{handler_raw + 0x10000:05x})\")\n\n# Count entries that could be item pickups (action_id &lt;= 255)\nitem_entries = [(a, h, o) for a, h, o in all_entries if a &lt;= 255]\nprint(f\"\\nEntries with action_id &lt;= 255 (potential item-related): {len(item_entries)}\")\nfor action_id, handler_raw, off in item_entries[:20]:\n    print(f\"  action={action_id}, handler=0x{handler_raw + 0x10000:05x}\")\n",

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nFor each of the 40 CALL sites to process_inventory_action (0x24157),\nlook backwards to find what value EAX was set to before the call.\nThis will give us the complete list of all item grants in the game.\n\"\"\"\nimport struct\n\ndef code_to_file(addr):\n    return addr - 0x10000 + 0x14200\n\nFIXUP = 0x10000\nPROC_INV = 0x24157\n\nwith open(\"files/JUEGO.EXE\", \"rb\") as f:\n    exe = f.read()\n\ncode_start = 0x14200\ncode_end = 0x43200\n\n# Find all CALL and JMP to process_inventory_action\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\nprint(\"ALL references to process_inventory_action (0x24157)\")\nprint(\"Both CALL (E8) and JMP (E9)\")\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\n\nrefs = []\nfor pos in range(code_start, code_end - 5):\n    opcode = exe[pos]\n    if opcode in (0xe8, 0xe9):\n        disp = struct.unpack_from('&lt;i', exe, pos + 1)[0]\n        ghidra = pos - 0x14200 + 0x10000\n        target = ghidra + 5 + disp\n        if target == PROC_INV:\n            kind = \"CALL\" if opcode == 0xe8 else \"JMP\"\n            refs.append((ghidra, kind, pos))\n\nprint(f\"Found {len(refs)} references total\")\nprint()\n\nfor ghidra, kind, file_pos in refs:\n    # Look backwards up to 30 bytes for MOV EAX, imm32 (B8 xx xx xx xx)\n    # or XOR EAX,EAX + MOV AX, imm16 (31 C0 ... 66 B8 xx xx)\n    found_eax = None\n    \n    # Check bytes before this instruction\n    look_back = min(50, file_pos - code_start)\n    before = exe[file_pos - look_back:file_pos]\n    \n    # Search backwards for the most recent MOV EAX instruction\n    for i in range(len(before) - 1, -1, -1):\n        if before[i] == 0xb8 and i + 5 &lt;= len(before):\n            val = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', before, i + 1)[0]\n            if val &lt; 500:  # reasonable item/action ID\n                found_eax = (val, \"MOV EAX\", look_back - i)\n                break\n    \n    # Also check for XOR EAX,EAX (31 C0) followed by MOV AX,[addr] pattern\n    # This means EAX comes from memory, not immediate\n    \n    ctx_before = exe[file_pos - 20:file_pos]\n    ctx_hex = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in ctx_before)\n    \n    if found_eax:\n        val, instr, dist = found_eax\n        print(f\"  {kind} at 0x{ghidra:05x}: EAX = {val:3d} (0x{val:02x}) via {instr}, {dist} bytes before | {ctx_hex}\")\n    else:\n        # Check for MOV AX, [memory] pattern (value comes from memory)\n        mem_ref = None\n        for i in range(len(before) - 5, -1, -1):\n            # 66 A1 xx xx xx xx = MOV AX, [addr]\n            if before[i] == 0x66 and i + 1 &lt; len(before) and before[i+1] == 0xa1:\n                if i + 6 &lt;= len(before):\n                    addr = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', before, i + 2)[0]\n                    mem_ref = f\"MOV AX, [0x{addr:05x}]\"\n                    break\n            # A1 xx xx xx xx = MOV EAX, [addr] (32-bit)\n            if before[i] == 0xa1 and i + 5 &lt;= len(before):\n                addr = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', before, i + 1)[0]\n                mem_ref = f\"MOV EAX, [0x{addr:05x}]\"\n                break\n        \n        if mem_ref:\n            print(f\"  {kind} at 0x{ghidra:05x}: EAX from {mem_ref} | {ctx_hex}\")\n        else:\n            print(f\"  {kind} at 0x{ghidra:05x}: EAX = ??? | {ctx_hex}\")\n\n# Also: double-check by looking specifically for the 10-byte pattern\n# B8 xx 00 00 00 E9 yy yy yy yy where target of JMP = process_inventory_action\nprint()\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\nprint(\"ITEM GRANT STUBS: MOV EAX, &lt;item&gt;; JMP process_inventory_action\")\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\n\nfor pos in range(code_start, code_end - 10):\n    if exe[pos] == 0xb8:  # MOV EAX, imm32\n        val = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', exe, pos + 1)[0]\n        if val &lt; 200 and exe[pos + 5] == 0xe9:  # JMP rel32\n            disp = struct.unpack_from('&lt;i', exe, pos + 6)[0]\n            ghidra = pos - 0x14200 + 0x10000\n            target = ghidra + 10 + disp\n            if target == PROC_INV:\n                print(f\"  0x{ghidra:05x}: MOV EAX, {val} (0x{val:02x}); JMP process_inventory_action\")\n",

So the real function entry points are:\n  Item 93: 0x21B4E (stub at 0x21B58)\n  Item 94: 0x21B62 (stub at 0x21B6C)\n  Item 95: 0x21B76 (stub at 0x21B80)  \n  Item 96: 0x21B8A (stub at 0x21B94)\n\nSearch for CALL/JMP to these entry points AND check if they appear in the F8 table\n(with -0x10000 fixup, i.e., table stores 0x1B76 for function at 0x21B76).\n\"\"\"\nimport struct\n\ndef code_to_file(addr):\n    return addr - 0x10000 + 0x14200\n\ndef data_to_file(addr):\n    return addr - 0x40000 + 0x43200\n\nwith open(\"files/JUEGO.EXE\", \"rb\") as f:\n    exe = f.read()\n\n# Verify the prologues exist\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\nprint(\"VERIFY FUNCTION PROLOGUES\")\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\n\nstubs = [\n    (93, 0x21B58),\n    (94, 0x21B6C),\n    (95, 0x21B80),\n    (96, 0x21B94),\n]\n\nentry_points = {}\nfor item_id, stub_addr in stubs:\n    # The prologue should be 10 bytes before: PUSH 4 (68 04 00 00 00) + CALL __STK (e8 xx xx xx xx)\n    entry_addr = stub_addr - 10\n    file_off = code_to_file(entry_addr)\n    prologue = exe[file_off:file_off + 20]\n    prologue_hex = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in prologue)\n    \n    is_prologue = prologue[0] == 0x68 and prologue[5] == 0xe8\n    entry_points[item_id] = entry_addr\n    \n    print(f\"  Item {item_id}: entry=0x{entry_addr:05x}, stub=0x{stub_addr:05x}\")\n    print(f\"    Bytes: {prologue_hex}\")\n    print(f\"    Valid prologue: {is_prologue}\")\n\n# Search for CALL/JMP to each entry point\nprint()\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\nprint(\"SEARCH: CALL/JMP to item grant function entry points\")\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\n\ncode_start = 0x14200\ncode_end = 0x43200\n\nfor item_id, entry_addr in entry_points.items():\n    found = []\n    for pos in range(code_start, code_end - 5):\n        opcode = exe[pos]\n        if opcode in (0xe8, 0xe9):\n            disp = struct.unpack_from('&lt;i', exe, pos + 1)[0]\n            ghidra = pos - 0x14200 + 0x10000\n            target = ghidra + 5 + disp\n            if target == entry_addr:\n                kind = \"CALL\" if opcode == 0xe8 else \"JMP\"\n                found.append((ghidra, kind))\n    \n    if found:\n        print(f\"  Item {item_id} (entry 0x{entry_addr:05x}):\")\n        for addr, kind in found:\n            print(f\"    {kind} from 0x{addr:05x}\")\n    else:\n        print(f\"  Item {item_id} (entry 0x{entry_addr:05x}): NO references found\")\n\n# Check if entry points appear in the F8 table (with -0x10000 stored in table)\nprint()\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\nprint(\"SEARCH: Entry points in F8 action table\")\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\n\n# Read all F8 table entries from 0x47e58\nf8_file = data_to_file(0x47e58)\npos = f8_file\nf8_entries = []\nwhile True:\n    action_id, handler_raw = struct.unpack_from('&lt;HI', exe, pos)\n    if action_id == 0xFFFF:\n        break\n    f8_entries.append((action_id, handler_raw))\n    pos += 6\n\n# Also read from 0x47d24 (the table used by execute_room_specific_script)\nt1_file = data_to_file(0x47d24)\npos = t1_file\nt1_entries = []\nwhile True:\n    action_id, handler_raw = struct.unpack_from('&lt;HI', exe, pos)\n    if action_id == 0xFFFF:\n        break\n    t1_entries.append((action_id, handler_raw))\n    pos += 6\n\nfor item_id, entry_addr in entry_points.items():\n    raw_handler = entry_addr -
